'''16th Night''' (Alt: ''Izayoi'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Kagerou]] and [[Oboro]].
== Effect ==
Buffs the caster with 16th Night status. For the duration of the skill:
*[[MATK]] is increased by [(Job Level / 2) x Skill Level].
*Fixed cast time is reduced by 100%.
*Variable cast time is reduced by 50%. The variable cast reduction stacks multiplicatively with variable cast reduction from other sources (e.g. [[Malangdo Enchants]]).

wikitext:
{{Update}} {{Skill Info |class=Biochemist |type=Offensive |levels=10 (fixed) |prereqs=([[Alchemist]]) [[Acid Terror]] Lv. 5, [[Bomb]] Lv. 5 |spcost=50 |cast_fix=1 second |delay=1 second |cooldown=0.15 seconds |target=Enemy |range=9 |catalyst=1 {{item |id=7136 Acid Bottle}}, 1 {{item |id=7135 Bottle Grenade}} }} '''Acid Bomb''' (Alt: ''Acid Demonstration'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2nd class offensive skill available as [[Biochemist]]. ==Effect== Consume 1 {{item |id=7135 Bottle Grenade}} and 1 {{item |id=7136 Acid Bottle}} to hurl the contents of both items at a targeted enemy to inflict ranged physical damage. The damage is affected by the caster's [[INT]] and the target's [[VIT]]. In [[PvP]], Acid Bomb has a (Skill Level)% chance to break the targeted character's weapon or armor. {| class="wikitablec" ! Level || Base Damage (ATK) || Chance to Break
Weapon / Armor |- ! 1 || 200% || 1% |- ! 2 || 400% || 2% |- ! 3 || 600% || 3% |- ! 4 || 800% || 4% |- ! 5 || 1,000% || 5% |- ! 6 || 1,200% || 6% |- ! 7 || 1,400% || 7% |- ! 8 || 1,600% || 8% |- ! 9 || 1,800% || 9% |- ! 10 || 2,000% || 10% |} '''Damage ([[ATK]]) =''' [Base_Damage × ({{tooltip|BaseLv ÷ 100|Lv100 ~ Lv185 = 100% ~ 185%}})]% == Applications == * Acid Bomb is an excellent skill for [[MVP]] scenarios due to its high damage and, in some cases, the value of MVP rewards in contrast to the cost of the skill's consumed items. * Acid Bomb's cast time is entirely fixed, so [[Sacrament]] can be used to cast in half the time. * [[Magic Strings]] can significantly reduce Acid Bomb's cast delay, increasing damage over time. This allows for very high rates of damage against any non-[[Ghost]] monster, particularly those with high [[VIT]]. ==Notes== *[[DEF|Defense]] values are not applied to this skill in the same way as they are applied to other skills. It appears that [[DEF#Hard DEF|Hard Defense]] is subtracted off the final damage value instead of reducing damage by a percent, basically treating it as [[DEF#Soft_DEF|Soft Defense]]. *Using [[Fire Expansion]] at level 5 gives off an Acid Bomb effect on 5x5 area which ignores PvP reduction and target DEF of Acid Bomb, but will be considered as magic skill when Acid Bomb is used this way. :''for more details on this part, refer to'' [[Fire Expansion#Notes|Fire Expansion]] *Bypasses: **[[Guard]] **[[Cicada Skin Shed]] & [[Mirror Image]] **[[Flee]] & [[DEF]] *Blocked by: **[[Kaupe]] **[[Pneuma]] (missed hits consume bombs) **[[Blinding Mist]] (75% chance for the skill to fail to connect. '''Acid Terror''' (Alt: ''Acid Terror'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Alchemist]] and [[Biochemist]].
==Effect==
Throws a bottle of corrosive acid at a single target that will inflict ranged [[ATK|physical damage]]. It has a chance of leaving the target [[Status Effects#Bleeding|bleeding]] or breaking its equipped armor. Each cast consumes an {{item|id=7136 Acid Bottle}}.

!rowspan=2|Base Damage (ATK)
!colspan=2|Chance of Effect

!Bleeding!!Armor Break

|-
!2
|400%||6%||15%
|-
!3
|600%||9%||25%
|-
!4
|800%||12%||35%
|-
!5
|1,000%||15%||45%
|-
|}
 '''Damage (ATK)''' = [Base_Damage + (Potion_Research_Lv x 100)]%

===Notes===
*This skill inflicts half damage against [[Boss Protocol|boss]] monsters.
*While the damage can be blocked by [[Pneuma]], the chance to break armor remains.
*[[Kyrie Eleison]] and [[Guard]] block both the damage and the chance of breaking armor.
*When the armor break occurs, the affected entity will display the "/omg" [[Emotes|emote]].
**Depending the server, that doesn't automatically mean they had their armor broken; even when using Chemical Protection or wearing an {{item|id=4061 Immortal}} armor, the /omg will display itself so long as the attack was considered a success.
*The damage is increased via [[ATK]] cards, and status cards have no effect.

==External==
===Bestowed from===
*{{item|id=4563 '''Creator Card'''}} - Level 5; Autocast on enemy when physically attacked, uses catalyst.

===Enhanced by===

*{{item|id=16001 Red Square Bag}} - Increases damage by 20%.

==History==
{{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Acid_Terror&oldid=59029 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates.

==Changelog==
*{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}}
**Chance to destroy target's armor increased.
***Old: 3% ~ 13%
***New: [((Skill Level - 1) x 10) + 5]%
**Damage type changed from special ranged physical damage to normal ranged physical damage.
**Damage formula changed.
***Old: [200% + (Skill Level x 80)]% (ATK + MATK)
***New: [(Skill Level x 200) + (Potion_Research_Lv x 100)]% ATK

'''Adrenaline Rush''' (Alt: ''Adrenaline Rush'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Blacksmith]] and [[Mastersmith]].
==Effect==
Places a temporary buff on the user and all party members that increases [[ASPD|Attack Speed]] and [[HIT|hit rate]] with [[Axe]] and [[Mace]] class weapons.

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!ASPD Boost!!HIT Boost!!Duration!!SP Cost
|-
!1
|rowspan=5|30% + 10%||8||30s||20
|-
!2
|11||60s||23
|-
!3
|14||90s||26
|-
!4
|17||120s||29
|-
!5
|20||150s||32
|}

===Notes===
*The [[ASPD|attack speed]] of [[Blacksmith]]s is increased by 30% while the [[ASPD|attack speed]] of other [[Classes|job classes]] is increased by 25%.
*When used via {{item|id=12220 Scroll}}, the user's [[ASPD|attack speed]] will increase by 30% regardless of their [[Classes|Job Class]]. However, it is increased by 25% if another party member uses the scroll or the actual skill.
*Some monsters have a more powerful variation of this skill, which lasts about 5 minutes. 
*This effect is removed by [[Decrease AGI]] and [[Quagmire]].
*There are two portion of bonus from this skills:
**30% is counted as [[ASPD#Skill_ASPD_Modifiers|Skill ASPD Modifiers]] in the [[ASPD#ASPD_Formula|ASPD formula]].
**10% is counted as [[ASPD#Equipment_ASPD_Modifiers|Equipment ASPD Modifiers]] in the [[ASPD#ASPD_Formula|ASPD formula]].

==External==
===Bestowed from===
*{{item|id=12220 Adrenaline Rush Scroll}} - Level 5; Usable. The user should be able to wield either axe or mace weapons, else it will do nothing.
*{{item|id=5469 Musketeer Hat}} - Level 1; Autocast when physically attacked (No weapon restriction)
*{{item|id=24272 Alchemist Shadow Armor}} + {{item|id=24259 Alchemist Shadow Shoes}} - Level 3; Usable ([[Alchemist]] class Only)
*[[Card_Sets#Alchemist Card Set|Alchemist Card Set]] - Level 1; Autocast when physically attacked ([[Alchemist]] class Only)

==History==
{{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Adrenaline_Rush&oldid=55880 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates.

==Changelog==
*{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}}
**Added 10% delay after attack reduction effects (counted as [[ASPD#Equipment_ASPD_Modifiers|Equipment ASPD Modifiers]] in the [[ASPD#ASPD_Formula|ASPD formula]]).
**Also increases Hit by (5 + (3 x Skill Level)).

'''Aid Berserk Potion''' (Alt: ''Berserk Pitcher'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Alchemist]] and [[Biochemist]]. This skill can only be used when the player is linked to the [[Alchemist Spirit]].
==Effect==
Throws two {{item|id=657 Berserk Potions}} at a single target, granting their effects temporarily regardless of their [[Classes|Job Class]].

==Known Bugs==
*This skill can be used on characters below [[Levels#Base Level|Level]] 85. However, the effects will not be granted, wasting the {{item|id=657 Berserk Potions}} in the process.

'''Ancilla''' (Alt: ''Ancilla'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Arch Bishop]].
==Effect==
Creates a single {{item|id=12333 Ancilla}}, consuming 1 {{item|id=717 Blue Gemstone}} and 10% of the user's [[Max SP]]. Ancilla can be used as a catalyst for [[Epiclesis]] or consumed to restore 15% of the user's [[Max SP]] and gaining a 60 second buff that increases effectiveness of healing by 15%, [[SP Recovery|SP recovery]] by 30% and converts [[Adoramus]] element to [[Neutral]].

===Notes===
*The user cannot have more than 3 {{item|id=12333 Ancillas}} in their inventory. Otherwise this skill will fail.
*Despite the SP cost of this skill is relative to [[Max SP]], it can be affected by all effects that alter SP cost, such as [[Offertorium]]. However, if the SP cost is reduced, it still requires to have at least 10% of the user's [[Max SP]] in order to cast it.

==History==
{{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Ancilla&oldid=50810 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2021 skill updates.

==Etymology==
*In Latin, ancilla means "maid / female servant."

wikitext: {{Skill Info |class=Hunter |class2=Mercenary |type=Active |levels=5, selectable |prereqs=([[Hunter]]) [[Skid Trap]] Lv. 1 |spcost=12 |delay=[[ASPD]] |duration=[300 − (Skill Level × 50)] seconds |target=Ground |area=3x3 |range_x=3 |catalyst=1 {{item|id=1065 Trap}} or {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} }} '''Ankle Snare''' (Alt: ''Ankle Snare'') is a 2nd class active skill available as [[Hunter]], [[Sniper]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]]. ==Effect== Sets a trap on a targeted location that will catch and immobilize any enemy that steps on it. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Base Effect Duration!!Trap Duration |- !1 |4s||250s |- !2 |8s||200s |- !3 |12s||150s |- !4 |16s||100s |- !5 |20s||50s |} '''{{tooltip|Effect Duration|Minimum is 7 seconds against players.}}''' = [Base_Effect_Duration − Target_AGI ÷ 10]s ===Notes=== *Although trapped enemies cannot move, they can still attack and use skills. *Enemies can also be released through [[Remove Trap]]. *Guild castles contain some map squares on which this trap is not visible. Even though it can't be seen, the snare is still there and functional. *If the triggering player or monster cannot be knocked back (during the [[War of Emperium]], [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] monsters or {{item|id=2125 Strong Shield}} users for example), they may move past a trap before coming to a stop. They may also occupy multiple snares. When this happens, the Effect Duration of the first trap they encountered determines how long they remain trapped. All of the traps they occupy will vanish at the same time. Using [[Remove Trap]] on any of the traps will remove all of them, but return only one Trap. *This trap cannot be pushed back. *This skill is required to be maxed out (Lv. 5) in order to unlock the arrow-related skills of a [[Ranger]]. ==About Traps== *If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill. *This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear. *Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]]. *Traps occupy 1 cell. *Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap. *Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environment. *Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP. *Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]]. *Like ground skills, traps can also be swept by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]]. ==Related Skills== *[[Remove Trap]] *[[Spring Trap]] *[[Detonator]] *[[Keen Nose]] *[[Hover]] *[[Trample]] {{Navbox Hunter}}

'''Aqua Benedicta''' (Alt: ''Aqua Benedicta'') is a 1<sup>st</sup> class active skill available as [[Acolyte]] and [[Super Novice]].
==Effect==
Draws water under the caster to create a single {{item |id=523 Holy Water}} from it. Requires the player to be in shallow water and each cast consumes an {{item|id=713 Empty Bottle}}.

===Notes===
*This skill can be cast on [[Sage]]'s [[Deluge]] and it does not consume the cells of it, so it is a viable alternative.

'''Arrow Shower''' (Alt: ''Arrow Shower'') is a 1<sup>st</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Archer]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].

==Effect==
Shoots an arrow that spreads over a targeted location to inflict ranged [[ATK|physical damage]] to all enemies and push them 2 cells backward within the area of effect. Each cast uses one [[Arrows|arrow]], of which property depends on the property of this skill.

*The Knock Back of this skill depends on where the enemies are relative to where the skill is used as shown above. If any monster is in the same cell as the targeted location, it will be knocked back westward. 
*This skill can hit [[Cloaking|cloaked]] entities.
*Animation Delay cannot be bypassed by movement or being hit.
*Traps can be moved around using this skill, much like how monsters/players are affected by usual [[:Category:Knock Back Skills|knock back skills]]. Using this method, it is possible to push traps beneath monsters, which is not directly possible.

title: Autocast
wikitext:
An '''autocast''' is the ability of a skill to be used without explicit activation. While some skills such as [[Double Attack]], [[Hindsight]] and the [[TaeKwon Kid]] stances trigger skills randomly on attack, the term is generally used for cards or equipment that give a certain chance of casting skills automatically when attacking or taking damage. Autocasting does not have any [[Skills#Cast Time|cast time]], nor does it require any [[Max SP|SP]] or catalyst. Autocasting will still incur the cast delay of a skill. '''Axe Boomerang''' (Alt: ''Axe Boomerang'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Mechanic]].
==Effect==
Inflicts Ranged [[ATK|Physical Damage]] to a single target and pushes it backwards. Requires to have an [[Axe]] class weapon equipped and the damage is greatly affected by its weight.

 <span style="white-space:normal;">'''Damage (ATK)''' = [(Base_Damage + Weapon_Weight) × ({{tooltip|BaseLv ÷ 100|Lv100 ~ Lv175 = 100% ~ 175%}})]%

===Notes===
*This skill can be used even when wearing the [[Madogear]].

==External==
===Enhanced by===
====Headgear====
*{{item|id=5907 Sea Captain Hat [1]}}:
**Reduced cooldown by 1 second.
**If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases damage by 40%.
====Weapon====
*{{item|id=28130 Avenger [2]}} - If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases damage by 40%.
*{{item|id=1396 Bellum Guillotine}} - Increases damage by 80% if upgrade level is +6 or higher.
*{{item|id=1326 Illusion War Axe [2]}}:
**Increases damage by 100%.
**If upgrade level is +7 or higher, increases damage by an additional 20%.
**If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases damage by an additional 20%.
====Shoes====
*{{item|id=470036 Illusion Military Boots}} - Increases damage by 20% per level of Axe Boomerang known.

====Accessory====
*{{item|id=490602 Power Machine Arm [1]}} - Increases damage by 1% for every 2 Base Level.

====Equipment Sets====
*[[Equipment_Sets#Illusion_Shoes_.26_Illusion_War_Axe_Set|Illusion Shoes & Illusion War Axe Set]] - If Illusion Shoes and Illusion War Axe upgrade level is +7 or higher, increases damage by 15%.
*[[Equipment Sets#Supplement Part Str & Supplement Part Dex Set|Supplement Part Str & Supplement Part Dex Set]]:
**Increases damage by 100%.
**Reduces cooldown by 2 seconds.
====Card====
*{{item|id=4698 Step Card}}:
**Increases damage by 30%.
**If upgrade level of the compounded item is +10 or higher, increases damage by an additional 30%.

'''B.S Sacramenti''' (Alt: ''Benedictio Sanctissimi Sacramenti'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Priest]] and [[High Priest]].
==Effect==
Blesses a targeted location to endow the armor of all players within the area of effect with the [[Holy]] property. Requires the user to have two [[Acolyte]] class players horizontally adjacent to the user (default camera view), whose SP is deducted by 10. Acts as ''Offensive Endowment'' when used against [[Undead]] property and [[Demon]] race monsters, which inflict [[Holy]] property damage that equals the half of the recovered HP from the [[Heal]] skill.

===Notes===
*Even though this skill requires the user to have 2 [[Acolyte]] classes next to the user, the skill will still work even if they are [[Hiding|hidden]], dead, not in the same guild and un[[party|partied]]. The only requirement is for them to be next to the user in a horizontal line.
*The skill will fail if any of the required [[Acolyte]] classes has under 10 SP.
*Can be used by having [[Game Master]]s instead of [[Acolyte]] class players.
*Unequipping armor does not cancel this skill, so elemental armor is rendered useless when under the effects of this skill.

==Etymology==
*The full name of this skill is ''Benedictio Sanctissimi Sacramenti'', which meaning is ''Benediction of the most Sacred Sacrament''.

*''Basilica'' (βασιλική) in Greek means "royal" or "kingly", derived from βασιλεῖος (basileios) meaning "king" or "royal".

*In religious context, it refers to a church that has been granted special privileges by the Pope.

{{Item List |id=7940 |item=Special Alloy Trap |num=1|simple=yes}} }} '''Blast Mine''' (Alt: ''Blast Mine'') is a 2nd class offensive skill available as [[Hunter]] and [[Sniper]]. ==Effect== Sets a trap that will explode after the trap duration expires or when an enemy steps on it, inflicting piercing [[Wind]] property damage to all enemies within its area of effect. This skill ignores the accuracy check. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Trap Duration |- !1 |25s |- !2 |20s |- !3 |15s |- !4 |10s |- !5 |5s |} '''Damage''' = [DEX × (3 + Base_Lv ÷ 100) × (1 + INT ÷ 35)] × Skill_Lv ± 10% + (Trap_Research_Lv × 40) ===Notes=== * This trap ignores the flag "Always Takes 1 Damage". * This trap ''can'' activate leech effects like {{item|id=4115 Hunter Fly Card}}, {{item|id=5208 Rideword Hat}}, and etc. * This trap ignores every relative damage modifier such as {{item|id=4058 Thara Frog}}, {{item|id=4442 Tatacho}}, {{item|id=4254 Ogretooth}} and {{item|id=4271 Giant Hornet}} cards in [[PvP]] environments. * This trap bypasses defensive benefits such as [[Guard]], [[Parry]] and [[Weapon Blocking]]. * This trap cannot be stacked as it will destroy all other traps in the area of effect. * A ranged attacker will attack this trap repeatedly even if /nc or /noctrl is disabled. * This trap can be activated by [[Detonator]], although the 3x3 range will still limit possible applications. * This is the only known trap that can get pushed back by normal attacks. This trap gets pushed back an additional 3 cells every time it recieves physical damage, even after getting knocked back by other skills like [[Arrow Shower]]. * This trap can be pushed back. The direction depends on where the trap is relative to the attacker as as provided below. If the trap is in the same cell as the attacker, it will be pushed westward. {|class="wikitablec mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="font-weight:bold;" !colspan=9|Knock Back positions |- |↖||↖||↖||↑||↑||↑||↗||↗||↗ |- |↖||↖||↖||↑||↑||↑||↗||↗||↗ |- |↖||↖||↖||↖||↑||↗||↗||↗||↗ |- |←||←||↖||↖||↑||↗||↗||→||→ |- |←||←||←||←||style="color:red;"|{{Tooltip|A|Attacker}}||→||→||→||→ |- |←||←||↙||↙||↓||↘||↘||→||→ |- |↙||↙||↙||↙||↓||↘||↘||↘||↘ |- |↙||↙||↙||↓||↓||↓||↘||↘||↘ |- |↙||↙||↙||↓||↓||↓||↘||↘||↘ |} ==About Traps== *Trap damage is considered '''[[Melee]]'''. *Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP. *Traps occupy 1 cell. *Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap. *If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill. *Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]]. *Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environments. *Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]]. *Traps cannot be activated by a [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that enticed the trapper with [[Siren's Voice]]. *Like ground skills, traps can also be swept by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]]. *This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear. ==Related Skills== *[[Remove Trap]] *[[Spring Trap]] *[[Detonator]] *[[Keen Nose]] *[[Hover]] *[[Trample]] ==History== {{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Blast_Mine&oldid=60802 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates. ==Changelog== *{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}} **Fixed casting time reduced from 1 second to 0.3 seconds. **0.5 seconds variable casting time added. **This trap can now activate HP/SP leech effects. {{Navbox Hunter}}

'''Blinding Mist''' (Alt: ''Wall of Fog'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Scholar]].
==Effect==
Creates an opaque mist on a targeted location that will cause [[Status Effects#Blind|blindness]] to all enemies inside it. Aggressive monsters affected by this skill will be unable to attack anyone unless they are adjacent to them as they have their sight range reduced.

===Effects inside===
When aiming '''any entity''' inside the mist:
*All single target skills will have a 75% chance to miss.
*Ranged attacks and {{tooltip|skills|Plus the 75% chance to miss.}} will have their damage reduced by 75% and their [[Stats#HIT|hit rate]] reduced by 50.

Monsters are also affected in the same manner, but the effects of the mist will continue for the duration of this skill even after the monster leaves the mist. This does not apply to players, who will lose all effects of the mist the moment they leave it.

===Notes===
*A maximum of two mists can be created before the first one expires.
*When this skill is cast on [[Deluge]], the duration of this skill is doubled.
*Does not prevent damage from area skills.
*This skill can be combined with [[Safety Wall]].
*[[Status Effects#Blind|Blind]] status from this skill does not affect the following entities:
**The user.
**Other players in [[PvM]] environment.
**[[Boss Protocol|Boss]] monsters.
**Monsters with high [[Stats#INT|INT]] and/or [[Stats#VIT|VIT]].
**[[Party]] members in [[PvP]] environment.
**[[Guild System|Guild]] and alliance members in [[War of Emperium]].

'''Bowling Bash''' (Alt: ''Bowling Bash'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Knight]], [[Lord Knight]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].
==Effect==
Strikes a single target with a smashing blow, where each strike will inflict [[ATK|physical damage]] individually to all enemies within the area of effect and push them backwards.

===Notes===
*The cast time cannot be interrupted.
*Even when used with a [[bow]] on a [[Rogue]] class, the skill is still considered Melee. Hence it is not blocked by [[Pneuma]], does not consume [[arrows]] and some effects such as the bonus for equipping a {{item|id=1752 Fire Arrow}} with {{item|id=1730 Burning Bow}} will not apply.
*The knockback effect will move the target into the direction the user has last moved or faced toward. When turning away from a target and then performing the skill, it results in the opposite effect where the target becomes drawn to the user.
*The knockback effect is applied before inflicting damage. Due to this, [[Safety Wall]] does '''not''' block the skill.
*Number of hit will change depends on weapon used.
**[[Two Handed Sword|Two-handed sword]]: number of hit will depends on number of targets.
***1 target: 2 hits
***2 ~ 3 targets: 3 hits
***>4 targets: 4 hits
**Any weapon beside [[Two Handed Sword|two-handed sword]]: skill will always deal 2 hits.

==Applications==
*This is one of two area skills a [[Knight]] can learn, the other being [[Brandish Spear]]. Unlike Brandish Spear however, this skill does not have weapon restriction. When used with two-handed swords, it inflicts more damage than Brandish Spear, although with a smaller [[Area of Effect|area of effect]]. On a Knights with high STR stats, this skill will be outdamaged by Brandish Spear which scale off STR. 
*In [[PvP]] environments, [[Knight]]s may be requested to tank and spread [[Status Effects|status effects]] instead of inflict damage. For this purpose, this skill has a small [[Area of Effect|area of effect]], making it less efficient for spreading [[Status Effects|status effects]]. This skill is still able to deal damage, and is useful for knocking back and scattering opponents.

wikitext:
{{Update}} {{Skill Info | class = Ranger | type = Active | levels = 5, fixed | prereqs = ([[Ranger]]) [[Ranger Main]] Lv. 1 | spcost = 40 | time = | delay = | duration = [[SP]] depletion or player is revealed | target = Self }} '''Camouflage''' (Alt: ''Camouflage'') is a 3rd class active skill available as [[Ranger]]. == Effect == Temporarily hide yourself from the view of enemies (only monsters, players will always see you) with the exception of [[Insect]], [[Demon]] and [[Boss]]-protocol monsters.
Each second in Camouflage grants +10 [[Crit]] and +30 [[ATK]] and reduces [[DEF]] by -5%, up to +100 [[Crit]] and +300 [[ATK]]. Camouflage is cancelled upon taking any action, however that action will still have its CRIT and ATK bonuses unless it's a trap skill. {| class="wikitable" !Level || 1 || 2 || 3 || 4 || 5 |- | align=center |Movement Speed (%)* || align=center colspan=2 | only usable on walls || align=center| 50 || align=center| 75 || align=center| 100 |- | align=center |SP drained per 1 second || align=center| 6 || align=center| 5 || align=center| 4 || align=center| 3 || align=center| 2 |} == Notes == *When used with a skill that has cast time, Camouflage is only deactivated after the cast finishes. Possible applications include: **Using an {{Item List|id=610|item=Yggddrasil Leaf|simple=yes}} to revive a fallen comrade while in risky areas where the frequent appearance of monsters will hinder the long cast from completing. **Safely casting an AoE skill while inside a group of unsuspecting monsters. *Being camouflaged doesn't block natural HP/SP regeneration, making it possible to stay camouflaged for indefinite periods of time with high enough Int. *Camouflaged players cannot be targeted by normal attacks from players (Skills can still be used on the Ranger) and is revealed on hit. *Camouflaged players can pick up items, talk to NPCs, and Deal People while camouflaged. *Camouflaged players can walk onto portals without changing maps, similarly to [[Cloaking]]. *The sound effect is played for every player on the screen when someone moves while camouflaged just like [[Banding]]. *MS reduction is additive with [[Wind Walker]], [[Increase AGI]] and [[Warg Rider]]. *Consumablle items can be freely used while camouflaged. However, teleporting items such as {{Item List|id=601|item=Fly Wings|simple=yes}} will cancel the skill after teleportation, despite the transparency of the ranger staying (a bug). *Unlike [[Warg Rider]], {{Item List|id=12622|item=Halter Mounts|simple=yes}} can be freely used while camouflaged and won't cancel the skill. */effect will remove the transparency of this skill. ==External== ===Enhanced by=== *{{item|id=470006 Sniping Shoes}}: If Electric Shock is level 5, reduces SP cost by 20. {{Navbox Hunter}}

'''Cast Ninja Spell''' (Alt: ''Zenkai'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Kagerou]] and [[Oboro]].

== Effect ==
Consume all of your seals to create a 5x5 area on the ground. This will inflict status ailments on targets entering it at a high rate.

* Fire Spell will cast [[Burning]] (same as [[Dragon Breath]] and [[Comet]]).
* Ice Spell will cast [[Freezing]] (same as [[Frost Misty]]) and [[Frozen]].
* Wind Spell will cast [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], and [[Deep Sleep]].
* Earth Charm will cast [[Stone Curse]] and [[Status_Effects#Poison|Poison]].

Furthermore, standing inside the AoE whilst having a weapon with the same element as the AoE will give an attack bonus.

=== Notes ===
* The attack bonus for standing inside the AoE is believed to be +200 Equipment Attack;
* The duration of the AoE depends on the number of charms. The chance does NOT depend on the amount of charms. The chance of casting a particular ailment is unknown;
* The AoE attempts to inflict the effect every 1 second;

*This skill can get the user "out" of any trap, [[Fiber Lock]], or [[Close Confine]] (provided another enemy is nearby to charge).

title: Chorus Skill
wikitext:
== Description ==

Chorus skills are 3rd class Maestro and Wanderer skills that can only be used with multiple Performers are in the same party and on the screen at the same time. This is an advantage over 2nd class Ensemble Skills where the requirement was that the two performers had to be of opposite gender and standing in adjacent cells. In addition, you can combine chorus skills with 2nd class ensembles and solo skills 

== Notes ==
*Chorus skills require at least two performers ([[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]], in any combination) in the same party, with an [[instrument]] and [[whip]] equipped and both players on the caster's screen.
*Unlike [[Ensemble Skill|Ensemble Skills]], Chorus Skills do not require both performers to know the skill, and the skill level cast will affect the outcome of the skill, even if another performer on the screen has learned a different level of the skill.
*If the caster has learned level 5 of [[Voice Lessons]] or higher, they will be able to cast Chorus Skills even while performing 2nd class solo songs or ensembles.
*The SP cost for all chorus skills is split among all performers in the party and applied to each performer as: SkillSPcost - ((skillSPcost / 10) * NumPerformers).
*The skill cannot be cast, however, if other performers don't have enough SP.
*After the balance patch, bonuses from additional performers are capped at 7 performers max.


The following skills are Chorus Skills:
*[[Great Echo]]  
*[[Dances with Wargs]]  
*[[Song of Mana]]  
*[[Lerad's Dew]]  
*[[Saturday Night Fever]]  
*[[Warcry from Beyond]]  
*[[Sinking Melody]]
*[[Destruction Song]]
*[[Infinite Humming]]

This skill ignores the accuracy check. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Trap Duration |- !1 |20s |- !2 |40s |- !3 |60s |- !4 |80s |- !5 |100s |} '''Damage''' = [DEX × (3 + Base_Lv ÷ 85) × (1.1 + INT ÷ 35)] × Skill_Lv ± 10% + (Trap_Research_Lv × 40) ===Notes=== * This trap ignores the flag "Always Takes 1 Damage". * This trap ''can'' activate leech effects like {{item|id=4115 Hunter Fly Card}}, {{item|id=5208 Rideword Hat}}, and etc. * This trap ignores every relative damage modifier such as {{item|id=4058 Thara Frog}}, {{item|id=4442 Tatacho}}, {{item|id=4254 Ogretooth}} and {{item|id=4188 Leib Olmai}} cards in [[PvP]] environments. * This trap bypasses defensive benefits such as [[Guard]], [[Parry]] and [[Weapon Blocking]]. * This trap cannot be stacked as it will destroy all other traps in the area of effect. * This trap can be activated by [[Detonator]]. * This trap can be pushed back. The direction depends on where the trap is relative to the attacker as as provided below. If the trap is in the same cell as the attacker, it will be pushed westward. {|class="wikitablec mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="font-weight:bold;" !colspan=9|Knock Back positions |- |↖||↖||↖||↑||↑||↑||↗||↗||↗ |- |↖||↖||↖||↑||↑||↑||↗||↗||↗ |- |↖||↖||↖||↖||↑||↗||↗||↗||↗ |- |←||←||↖||↖||↑||↗||↗||→||→ |- |←||←||←||←||style="color:red;"|{{Tooltip|A|Attacker}}||→||→||→||→ |- |←||←||↙||↙||↓||↘||↘||→||→ |- |↙||↙||↙||↙||↓||↘||↘||↘||↘ |- |↙||↙||↙||↓||↓||↓||↘||↘||↘ |- |↙||↙||↙||↓||↓||↓||↘||↘||↘ |} ==About Traps== *Trap damage is considered '''[[Melee]]'''. *Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP. *Traps occupy 1 cell. *Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap. *If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill. *Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]]. *Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environments. *Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]]. *Traps cannot be activated by a [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that enticed the trapper with [[Siren's Voice]]. *Like ground skills, traps can also be swept by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]]. *This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear. ==Related Skills== *[[Remove Trap]] *[[Spring Trap]] *[[Detonator]] *[[Keen Nose]] *[[Hover]] *[[Trample]] ==External== ===Enhanced by=== *{{item|id=24279 Hunter Shadow Armor}}: **Increases damage by 20%. **For every upgrade level, increases damage by an additional 5%. ==History== {{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Claymore_Trap&oldid=60801 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates. ==Changelog== *{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}} **Fixed casting time reduced from 1 second to 0.3 seconds. **0.5 seconds variable casting time added. **This trap can now activate HP/SP leech effects. {{Navbox Hunter}}

A maximum of 1 trap can be placed at once. Permanently changes the monster that steps on this trap and any monster in a 5x5 area around this trap to [[Water]] Element. Does not affect boss type monsters or players, and consumes one Crystal  Blue and a Special  Alloy Trap.

* This trap disappears instantly once activated.
* This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]].
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].

'''Coin Flip''' (Alt: ''Flip the Coin'') is an Expanded class active skill available as [[Gunslinger]].
==Effect==
Flips a coin. If it lands showing heads, the user will gain 1 coin, and if it lands showing tails, the user will lose 1 coin. The user can gain a maximum of 10 coins and the level of the skill affects the chance of landing showing heads. Each use consumes 1 [[Zeny]].

===Notes===
*[[Gunslinger]]'s coins are displayed as glowing orbs around the user, similar to a [[Monk]]'s [[Spirit Sphere]]s.
*This skill is required to use many of the [[Gunslinger]] skills, as many require coins to perform.

'''Contract with Kafra''' (Alt: ''Kafra Contract'') is a special passive skill available to [[Guild System|Guild masters]].
==Effect==
Allows a guild to hire a [[Kafra]] employee for their territory. The Kafra Service is only available to the members of the guild that currently holds the castle. 

===Notes===

'''Convenio''' (Alt: ''Gather'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Arch Bishop]].
==Effect==

Summons party members on the same map to the caster's location.

The skill cannot be used on PVP areas.

The skill can be used only when caster is a party leader, cannot be used if not in a party.

===Notes===

*Can not be used while caster is standing on top of a cell that's being occupied by a floor skill such as [[Safety Wall]], [[Pneuma]], etc
*Map restrictions for this skill are currently unknown as it works on some maps where [[Teleport]] is disabled, [[Warp Portal]] is disabled.
**Most of the maps that spawn older MVPs have this skill disabled.
*This skill can be used in all [[instance|instances]] except [[Sealed Shrine]].
*If any party member is not being summoned, ask them to be sure their /call is opened.

==Etymology==
Convenio is Latin for “Gather” or “Come together”.

Until retaliation |target=Self }} '''Counter Attack''' (Alt: ''Auto Counter'') is a 2nd class offensive skill available as [[Knight]] and [[Lord Knight]]. ==Effect== Performs a stance that allows the user to block and retaliate a physical attack back to the attacker with a critical hit, ending the stance. The user must be facing the enemy in order to retaliate an enemy's attack. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!{{Tooltip|Duration|The time frame when an attack can be retaliated}} |- !1 |0.4s |- !2 |0.8s |- !3 |1.2s |- !4 |1.6s |- !5 |2.0s |} ===Notes=== *Offensive skills cannot be retaliated by this skill. *The critical hit from this skill will still have an [[ASPD]]-based delay. Therefore, higher [[ASPD]] is required to use this skill effectively against fast-attacking opponents. ==Applications== *All [[monster]]s, including [[Boss Protocol|boss]]es, can have their physical attacks blocked and retaliated by this skill. This makes it ideal for tanking. However, it is less effective against multiple opponents, as the user must be facing a monster to counter its attacks. *Alternatively, the user can start this stance and then click on a monster within range during the skill. Their attack will have twice the chance to be a critical hit and will gain 20 accuracy. *In [[PvP]] environment, this skill is generally less useful as it cannot block skill damage. *This skill works with [[Double Attack]]. {{Navbox Knight}}

'''Create Hell Tree''' (Alt: ''Hell Tree'') is a 4<sup>th</sup> class support skill available as [[Biolo]].

==Effect==
Summon a '''Hell Tree''' to aid player in combat.

* Only 1 [[Create Hell Tree|Hell Tree]] can be summoned at a time.
* '''Hell Tree''' casts a {{Status Icon|name=Hell Dusty|file=I_Hell_Tree|linkTo=Create Hell Tree}} buff on the user roughly every 40 seconds. 
** The buff increase 20% long range damage and damage against [[Formless]] and [[Plant]], last 30 seconds.

'''Crimson Marker''' (Alt: ''Crimson Marker'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Rebel]]. 
==Effect==
Mark a target with Crimson Death Mark, reducing its [[Flee]] by 10 and allows the caster to track the target on the mini-map.

Only a maximum of 3 Crimson Markers can be active at a time.

Boosts [[Quick Draw Shot]], [[Dragon Tail]] and [[Hammer of God]] effect.

wikitext: __NOTOC__ {{Skill Info |class=Sage |type=Active |levels=5 |prereqs=([[Sage]]) [[Spell Breaker]] Lv. 3 |spcost=None |cast_fix=0.4 seconds |cast_var=1.6 seconds |delay=[[ASPD]] |target=Enemy |range_x=9 |catalyst=1 {{item|id=715 Yellow Gemstone}} }} '''Dispell''' (Alt: ''Dispell'') is a 2nd class active skill available as [[Sage]] and [[Scholar]]. ==Effect== Attempts to nullify the majority of the stat changes, benefits and status effects of a single target. Each successful cast consumes a {{item|id=715 Yellow Gemstone}}. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Success Rate |- !1 |60% |- !2 |70% |- !3 |80% |- !4 |90% |- !5 |''100%'' |} ===List of unaffected benefits=== There are certain buffs which cannot be dispelled: *Chemical Protection skills of [[Alchemist]]s. *[[Status Effects#Divest|Divest]] status of [[Rogue]] skills. *[[Enchant Deadly Poison]]. *[[Hindsight]]. *[[Ninja Aura]]. *Players using shields with {{item|id=4128 '''Golden Thiefbug Card'''}} cannot be dispelled. *[[NPC_POWERUP|Power Up]]. *[[Stalker]]s and [[Shadow Chaser]]s linked with the [[Rogue Spirit]] are immune. *[[Soul Linker]]s are naturally immune. *[[Shattering Strike]]. *[[TaeKwon Kid]]'s [[Mild Wind]], [[Tumbling]], and kick stances. *[[TaeKwon Master]]'s Heat skills. *[[Movement Speed]] boost gained from items. *[[Arclouse Dash]]. *[[Cart Boost]]. *Food Items purchased from the [[Kafra Shop]]. *[[Gunslinger]]'s self buffs. *[[Arch Bishop]]'s [[Duple Light]], [[Expiatio]], and [[Lauda Agnus]] / [[Lauda Ramus|Ramus]] stat bonuses. *[[Royal Guard]]'s [[Reflect Damage]], [[Inspiration]], [[Exceed Break]], [[Vanguard Force]] and [[Banding]]. *[[Sura]]'s [[Rising Dragon]], [[Gentle Touch-Energy Gain]], [[Gentle Touch-Convert]] and [[Gentle Touch-Revitalize]]. ===Notes=== *This skill works on guild mates and allies in [[PvP]] environment when holding the Shift key. [[Party]] members can also be targeted in non-PvP areas. *If skill is not mastered, target's [[MDEF|magic defense]] lowers the chance of effect. ==Applications== *This skill is not widely used in [[PvM]] environments, but is a heavily favored skill in [[PvP]]. Most [[classes]] have specific buffs and usable items that ensure their efficiency, and this skill is capable of removing many of them. The opponent is therefore forced to continue with limited abilities or re-buff themselves. Certain classes have skills that ''require'' a specific buff to be active, such as [[Monk]]'s [[Guillotine Fist]] which requires [[Fury]] to be active, or [[Paladin]]'s [[Martyr's Reckoning]] which is a self-buff until it is consumed. This allows this skill to temporarily disable such classes effectively. *Most [[Sage]]s, [[Scholar]]s and [[Sorcerer]]s interested in [[PvP]] will want a high level of this skill. It can, however, be simply recast if an attempt fails, making lower levels of this skill still viable. ==Etymology== Although the correct English spelling would be "Dispel" ({{plainlink|url=http://www.thefreedictionary.com/dispel some}} {{plainlink|url=http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/dispel examples}}), kRO's skillnametable.txt lists it as SA_DISPELL, where SA stands for [[Sage]]. Subsequently, it has been translated as "Dispell" for iRO. For consistency's sake the article uses iRO's spelling. ==External== ===Bestowed from=== *{{item|id=19391 Eyes of Illusion}} - Level 5; Usable, if [[Hallucination Drug]] is at maximum level. *{{item|id=4407 '''Randgris Card'''}} - Level 1; Autocast on the target when performing a physical attack. {{Navbox Sage}}

wikitext:
{{Skill Info | class = Oboro | type = Active | levels = 5 | prereqs = ([[Kagerou]]) & ([[Oboro]]) [[Illusion-Bewitch]] Lv. 1 | spcost = 50 + (Skill Level x 10) | hpcost = | cast_fix = 2 seconds | cast_var = [0.5 + (Skill Level x 0.5)] seconds | delay = 1 second | cooldown = 30 seconds | duration = 45 + (Skill Level x 15) seconds | target = Any Entity | range = 7 |s_icon = Distorted Crescent }} '''Distorted Crescent''' (Alt: ''Zangetsu'') is an Expanded 2nd class active skill available as [[Oboro]]. == Effect == Modifies the target's [[ATK]] and [[MATK]] to be higher or lower, depending on the target's [[HP]] and [[SP]] when the buff is applied. ATK change is based on the target's current HP; an EVEN amount of HP increases the target's ATK, while an ODD amount of HP decreases the target's ATK. The same applies for MATK, except the target's SP is used instead. The buff is applied ''after'' the skill is successfully cast; therefore, when using the skill on yourself, you must have even SP after casting it in order to gain a MATK increase. {|class="wikitablec" ! rowspan=2|Level || rowspan=2|Target's HP or SP is EVEN

'''1,134''' is an EVEN number since it ends with ''4'', so you gain the matk ''increase''. *If you have '''1,234''' Current SP and you cast the skill at lvl 2 while also equipping a Pharaoh Card (70 SP Cost with -30% SP Cost = 49 SP Cost), you will be left with a new current SP of '''1,175'''.

'''Earth Spike''' (Alt: ''Earth Spike'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Wizard]], [[High Wizard]], [[Sage]], [[Scholar]] and [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|expanded]] [[Super Novice]].
==Effect==
Commands the ground beneath a single target to rise into spikes, where each spike will inflict 200% [[Earth]] property [[MATK|magic damage]].

===Notes===
*Despite the animation, all damage is connected in one single bundle.
*This skill is the only single-target spell (cast by players) capable of hitting [[Hiding|hidden]] enemies. However, it must be cast while the enemy is still visible.
*Since '''this is not a Bolt skill''' (despite being triggered by [[Vanilmirth]]'s [[Caprice]]), it is completely unaffected by [[Double Bolt]] and cannot be used in conjunction with [[Spell Fist]].
*In addition to Level 1 [[Stone Curse]], [[Sage]] classes also have a prerequisite of Level 1 [[Endow Quake]] while [[Super Novice]]s have a prerequisite of doing the [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|Expansion Quest]] instead. [[Wizard]] classes only require Level 1 [[Stone Curse]].

'''Electric Shock''' (Alt: ''Electric Shocker'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

==  Effect ==
Causes immobilization in a 5x5 area around this trap and drains the targets' SP for 20s. Electric Shock cannot be removed with the hunter skill [[Remove Trap]]. You need 1 Special Alloy Trap to place this trap. You can only place 3 at a time.

 '''Duration''' = (18 + 2 * Skill Level) - [(Target’s AGI + VIT)/10] * 0.7 seconds

===  Notes ===
* This trap can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players and monsters.
** '''Unlike other traps however, this trap's placement is also blocked by homunculi, pets, and visible AND invisible NPC's.'''
* This trap will yield 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]].
* This trap has a 3x3 activation area and can only activate 0.5s after it has been placed.
* This trap's activation cannot be avoided with [[Hover]].
* This trap disappears instantly once activated, therefore trap skills that can be placed under target feet (fire trap, ice trap, element changing trap) can be used.
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].
* This trap can be knocked back.
* If the triggering player or monster cannot be knocked back (Players using {{item |id=2125 Strong Shield}} or in WoE and [[Boss]] monsters for example), they may move past a snare before coming to a stop. They may also occupy multiple snares. When this happens, the Immobilization Duration of the first snare they encountered determines how long they remain trapped. All of the snares they occupy will vanish at the same time.

== General Trap information ==
* Trap Duration (but not Immobilization Duration) lasts 4 times as long in WoE.
* Traps occupy 1 cell.
* Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to another Trap.
* Traps can be activated by and will affect both allies and enemies in [[PVP]] and [[WoE]].
* Traps will not activate if the caster is under the effect of [[Manhole]].
* Traps cannot be activated by the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that charmed the caster with [[Siren's Voice]].
* [[Siren's Voice]] protects the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] from traps of charmed trappers.
* Traps can be removed by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]].

Expends summoned elemental's magic to create a magical barrier on the cells the caster and party members are standing on. Magical barrier dissipates once its durability reaches 0 or when skill duration ends.

* Barrier's durability/HP is same as [[Safety Wall]] lv 10 (unconfirmed if this depends on Safety Wall, most Sorcerers pick this skill lv 10)

title: Ensemble Skill
wikitext:
'''Ensemble Skills''' require a [[Bard]]/[[Minstrel]] and [[Dancer]]/[[Gypsy]] in the same party, with a [[whip]] and [[instrument]] equipped and standing next to each other to play. Either the Bard or Dancer can initiate the song; the other participant is forced to cooperate, although he or she can still cancel the skill afterwards using [[Amp]]. Like all play skills, the songs do not affect the caster, however the other half of the ensemble will be affected by it. If the Bard and Dancer have different levels of the same ensemble, the lower one will be used. While using an Ensemble Skill, the Bard and Dancer will not be able to attack or move but they can still use [[Melody Strike]] and [[Slinging Arrow]]. [[Skilled Special Singer]] removes this limitation immediately. The following songs are Ensemble Skills: 

*[[Acoustic Rhythm]] 
*[[Battle Theme]] 
*[[Classical Pluck]] 
*[[Down Tempo]] 
*[[Harmonic Lick]] 
*[[Lullaby]]

'''Epiclesis''' (Alt: ''Epiclesis'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Arch Bishop]].
==Effect==
Places a 5x5 area around the targeted location that resurrects dead players, increases [[Max HP]], and regenerates HP and SP every 3 seconds. This also reveals all concealed entities every 5 seconds. Each cast consumes 1 {{item|id=523 Holy Water}}, 1 {{item|id=12333 Ancilla}}, and 300 SP regardless of the skill level.

===Notes===
*Resurrection only occurs once, when the skill is cast and affects all allies within the area of effect. This means that only players within the area will be resurrected.
*Enemies in [[PvP]] environment will not be resurrected.
*[[Undead]] property players receive no benefits from this skill.
*The revealing effect affects all players, including the caster and allies, and doesn't cancel [[Invisibility]] or [[Stealth]].
*This skill bypasses the healing restriction from [[Frenzy]] and [[Weight Limit|overweight]] statuses.
*This skill stacks with [[Sanctuary]], which means players can recover HP faster by combining both skills.
*The effects of this skill do not remain once leaving the area of effect.

*''Epiclesis'' is when the priest asks the Holy Spirit during the Eucharistic Prayer to transform the bread and wine into the Body and Blood of Christ.

===Notes===
*This skill does affect [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] [[monster]]s.
*Targets trapped in the Vacuum are able to move immediately if the skill ends prematurely ([[Ganbantein]], [[Magnetic Earth]]).
*In [[War of Emperium]]:
**Targets can move past a Vacuum and are only subject to its effect if they come to a stop in Vacuum area.
**The skill duration begins when the target steps into the [[Area of Effect]]. As the target continues to move to their destination cell, the duration decreases. With a long or slow enough movement, the duration may end before or as they reach their original destination, allowing them to continue moving.
*This skill is currently disabled in dungeons and [[Endless Tower]].

When the trap, activates it deals damage in a 5x5 area and causes [[Burning]] status. Increased skill level increases the chance to status. To use the skill you need 1 Special Alloy Trap. Cause fire element damage. {| class=wikitable style="border 1em #aaaaaa solid" |- | align=center| '''Level''' || align=center | '''Chance''' |- | align=center| 1 || align=center | 60% |- | align=center| 2 || align=center | 70% |- | align=center| 3 || align=center | 80% |- | align=center| 4 || align=center | 90% |- | align=center| 5 || align=center | 100% |- |} '''Damage Formula''': ATK 100% + [{(Fire Trap Skill Level x Caster’s DEX) + (INT x 5)} x (1.5 + Caster’s Base Level / 100)] x {(Trap Research Skill Level x 20) / 100 } === Notes === * This trap can be placed under players and monsters. * This trap will yield 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]]. * This trap has a 3x3 activation area and can only activate 0.5s after it has been placed. * This trap's activation cannot be avoided with [[Hover]]. * This trap WILL hit cloaked enemies but will NOT hit Hidden/Stealth Players/Monsters. ** Hunter Traps will hit both. * This trap disappears instantly once activated. * This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]]. * This trap can be activated by [[Detonator]]. * This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]]. * This trap can be blocked by [[Guard]], [[Parry]] and [[Weapon Blocking]]. * This trap can activate effects like Hunter Fly card, Rideword Hat and etc. * The Damage is split into 2 portions, ATK portion and everything else will be called that stat portion. * Stat portion will bypass [[DEF]] and [[Flee]]. * Stat portion bypass [[Race]], [[Element]] and [[Size]] damage effects like Thara Frog, Tatacho and Ogretooth Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]]. * Stat portion bypass [[Element]] resistance effects like Hode Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]]. * ATK portion is affected by [[DEF]] and [[Flee]]. * ATK portion is affected by [[Race]], [[Element]] and [[Size]] damage effects like Thara Frog, Tatacho and Ogretooth Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]]. * ATK portion is affected by [[Element]] resistance effects like Hode Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]]. * ATK portion is affected by [[Element]] which can be used to do bonus damage but is still considered [[Neutral]] when used against Ghost type targets. == General Trap information == * Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in WoE. * Traps occupy 1 cell. * Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to another Trap. * Traps can be activated by and will affect both allies and enemies in [[PVP]] and [[WoE]]. * Traps will not activate if the caster is under the effect of [[Manhole]]. * Traps cannot be activated by the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that charmed the caster with [[Siren's Voice]]. * [[Siren's Voice]] protects the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] from traps of charmed trappers. * Traps can be removed by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]]. * Trap damage is considered [[Melee]] and will be blocked by [[Safety Wall]]. * Trap damage is considered [[Melee]] and can be increased with [[Enchant Blade]]. * Trap damage is reflected back to the caster by [[Shield Reflect]] and {{item |id= 2524 Valkyrian Manteau}}. * Damage traps gains "Killed by a melee attack" effects like {{item|id=4279 Earth Deleter Card}}. * Damage traps gains "Each attack has chance of" effects like {{item|id=4411 Vanberk Card}}. * Damage traps gains [[SP]] Drain/Gain effects like {{item|id=1234 Moonlight Dagger}} or {{item|id=4281 Zipper Bear Card}}. {{Navbox Hunter}}

(Skill Level + 2) hits |target=Ground |range=Magic |area=1x3 |knock=2 |element=Fire }} '''Fire Wall''' (Alt: ''Fire Wall'') is a 1st class offensive skill available as [[Mage]] and [[Super Novice]]. ==Effect== Creates a wall of flame on a targeted location that will inflict 50% [[Fire]] property [[MATK|magic damage]] and push enemies two cells backwards upon contact. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Cast Time!!Duration!!Hit Limit |- !1 |2.00s||5s||3 |- !2 |1.85s||6s||4 |- !3 |1.70s||7s||5 |- !4 |1.55s||8s||6 |- !5 |1.40s||9s||7 |- !6 |1.25s||10s||8 |- !7 |1.10s||11s||9 |- !8 |0.95s||12s||10 |- !9 |0.80s||13s||11 |- !10 |0.65s||14s||12 |} ===Notes=== *A maximum of three fire walls can be created before the first one expires. *This skill hits at a very high rate of attack: approximately 40 to 50 times per second. Be aware that if there is any significant lag, fast-moving enemies can pass through fire walls without being hit. *If the user is incapacitated ([[Status Effects#Stun|Stunned]], [[Status Effects#Frozen|Frozen]], [[Status Effects#Stone|Petrified]]), then this skill will not process attacks. *[[Boss Protocol|Boss]] monsters are not pushed back by this skill. However, they must take all hits in a fire wall cell before they can proceed. *Fire walls are aligned such that they are generally perpendicular to a line formed by the caster and the cast point, with the center cell being on the cast point. Fire walls with the caster's position as the cast point are aligned north-south on the map. *Immobile enemies, when hit by this skill, will be pushed southward. ==Applications== *Since [[Undead]] property entities are neither blocked nor pushed back by this skill, they may pass through any active cell before it has delivered all its hits. [[Quagmire]] may be used to slow down fast-moving [[Undead]] property enemies so that more hits are inflicted. *See [[Mystical Amplification]] for special notes on Fire Wall usage with that skill. ==External== ===Bestowed from=== *{{item|id=698 Level 1 Fire Wall}} - Level 1; Once *{{item|id=699 Level 5 Fire Wall}} - Level 5; Once *{{item|id=2824 Mage Manual}} - Level 1; Usable *{{Item List |id=490410 |item=Into The Abyss |slots=1 |simple=yes}} - Level 10; Usable *{{Item List |id=490733 |item=Khalitzburg White Gauntlets |slots=1 |simple=yes}} - Level 10; Usable ===Enhanced by=== *{{item|id=18992 New Year Hairpin}} - Increases the damage by 5% per refine level when equipped with {{item|id=4327 Bloody Butterfly Card}} *{{item|id=4327 Bloody Butterfly Card}} - Increases the damage by 5% *{{item|id=24254 Magician Shadow Pendant}}: **Increases damage by 20%. **For every upgrade level, increases damage by an additional 5%. ==External Links== *[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ekCsY8ASWRw Firewall techniques] {{Navbox Mage}} {{Navbox SuperNovice}}

==About Traps==
*If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill.
*This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning  message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause  this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear.
*Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]].
*Traps occupy 1 cell.
*Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap.
*Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environment.
*Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP.
*Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]].
*Like ground skills, traps can also be swept by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]].
*[[Siren's Voice]] protects the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] from traps of enticed trappers.

'''Frenzy''' (Alt: ''Berserk'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Lord Knight]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].
==Effect==
Unleashes the power of rage to greatly strengthen the user temporarily at cost of leaving him/her extremely vulnerable.

===List of positive effects===
*Increases [[ASPD]] by {{tooltip|30%|Does not stack with Twohand Quicken}}.
*Increases [[ATK]] by {{tooltip|100%|Does not stack with Buff ATK or Mastery ATK}}.
*Increases [[Max HP]] to 300% and replenishes it fully.
*{{tooltip|Improves|Only stacks with mount}} [[Movement Speed]].
*Resists flinching from enemy attacks.

===List of negative effects===
*Sets SP to 0.
*Disables [[SP Recovery]] and will remain disabled for 5 minutes after this skill runs out.
*Drains 5% of [[Max HP]] every 15 seconds.
*Sets all defense (both [[DEF|physical]] and [[MDEF|magic]]) to 0.
*Halves [[FLEE|Flee rate]].
*Does not allow:
**Use of skills. However, most skills triggered via [[Autocast]] still work.
**Changing equipment.
**[[Basic Game Control#Communication|Chatting]].
**Use of items.
*Forfeits [[Heal|healing]], except from Geographers created via [[Summon Flora]] and [[Tuna Belly]].

===Notes===
*Some cards and equipment that replenish HP implicitly (no green number shown) will still heal the user. For example: {{item|id=4158 Sky Deleter card}} works; {{item|id=1136 Solar Sword}} or {{item|id=4115 Hunter Fly cards}} do not work.
*After this skill runs out, [[SP Recovery]] can still be restored by relogging, like the similar effect after casting [[Guillotine Fist]].
*While chatting in public or guild channels is not permitted, it is still possible to set up chat rooms to communicate with nearby players.
*This skill runs out when 100 HP or less is calculated to be reached: the player will be left with exactly 100 HP, and their HP will never actually drop below 100.
*Relogging will cancel this skill and leave its user with 100 [[HP]].

==Applications==
===PvM===
*Leveling with this skill is possible, even with its massive restrictions. The only difficulty is having enough SP to continually recast this skill, as it consumes 200 SP, prevents [[SP Recovery]], and sets SP to 0. Other skills, such as [[Aura Blade]] and [[Spear Dynamo]] should also be used every time this skill runs out, requiring even more SP.
*Some methods of quickly restoring SP:
**[[Healing Items#SP Restoration Items|SP Items]]: These items will have to be used every time this skill runs out which can be regularly. HP may deplete very quickly in leveling areas with high level monsters (due to this skill's 0 defense penalty in combination with its 5% HP drain every 15 seconds), thus bringing the player to 100 HP often and canceling this skill sooner.
**SP Cards: There are [[Card Reference#Drain SP (weapon)|race-specific cards]] that replenish SP when the respective race is killed, and are compounded to weapons. {{item|id=4279 Earth Deleter card}} and {{item|id=4606 Undead Knight F card}} are the most ideal as they can be compounded to armor and garment instead of weapon, work on all races of monsters, and won't take the place of a card that increases damage. The goal with these cards is to kill enough monsters to replenish enough SP to be able to reuse this skill before the HP drains to 100.
**[[Scholar]] or [[Sorcerer]]: Not only can these players cancel out unneeded Frenzy with [[Dispell]], they can use [[Soul Exhale]] to recover the player's SP.

===PvP===
*The [[Max HP]] bonus from this skill can be used to survive nearly anything. This skill can be used before an opponent uses [[Guillotine Fist]], hopefully giving the player enough HP to survive. The long term usefulness of this is debatable, however, because it leaves the player in a very vulnerable state.
*While this skill is useful for breaking [[War of Emperium|emperiums]], the [[Movement Speed]] bonus from this skill is helpful for rushing through forts to reach the Emperium long before opponents.
*{{item|id=4141 Evil Druid carded}} armor is a wise choice when breaking Emperiums while under the effects of this skill. Otherwise, [[Priest]]s can cast [[Aspersio]] on frenzied players (rendering them unable to inflict any damage to the Emperium), and this skill prevents them from switching weapons or using items to counteract it.

==Tips==
*When this skill is [[Dispell]]ed, the player's [[Max HP]] will be back to normal. This skill can be immediately reused if the player has at least 200 SP.
*Remember to use all items (such as [[ASPD Potion]]s) and equip all gear desired before using this skill.

*{{item|id=28492 Thieves's Guide Vol. 1 [1]}} - Level 1; Usable, if [[Masquerade-Unlucky]] is at maximum level

===Notes===
*This is a disabling skill, since [[Status Effects#Frozen|Frozen]] status stops any [[monster]]s immediately. From this point, it is possible to cast a high-damage skill without fearing retaliation from the monster, unless it breaks free in time.
*[[Status Effects#Frozen|Frozen]] enemies become Level 1 [[Water]] property regardless of their original property. This means they become more vulnerable to [[Wind]] property skills, such as [[Lightning Bolt]] or [[Jupitel Thunder]], while frozen.
*This skill does not freeze [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] or [[Undead]] property monsters, although it will still deal damage to them.
*If a [[Mage]] decides to become a [[Wizard]], the skill [[Storm Gust]] can replace the need of this skill for mobs. The other disabling skill, [[Stone Curse]], is also an option.

==Effect==
Use the knowledge of pressure point techniques, to improve your fighting spirit which allows you gain Spirit Spheres when you deal or receive physical damage.

* Increases {{Skill List|id=273|skill=Raging Thrust|simple=yes}}, {{Skill List|id=372|skill=Chain Crush Combo|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=371|skill=Glacier Fist|simple=yes}} damage while this skill is active.

===Notes===
* This effect works in conjunction with normal attacks and skills.

==Applications==
* When used with area of effect skills such as {{Skill List|id=2518|skill=Lightning Ride|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=2332|skill=Rampage Blast|simple=yes}} while tanking many monsters at once, this skill practically allows the user to avoid having to use {{Skill List|id=401|skill=Zen|simple=yes}} continuously.
* [[Sura]]s can also use cheap skills such as {{Skill List|id=2337|skill=Windmill|simple=yes}} or {{Skill List|id=2328|skill=Earth Shaker|simple=yes}} when surrounded by monsters to gain Spirit Spheres in this manner.
* Using this skill before activating {{Skill List|id=268|skill=Mental Strength|simple=yes}} may allow the user to maintain Spirit Spheres until after its duration finishes, making it possible to immediately cast it again.

'''Grand Cross''' (Alt: ''Grand Cross'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Crusader]] and [[Paladin]].
==Effect==
Inflicts [[Holy]] property [[ATK|Hybrid]] [[MATK|Damage]] 1 to 3 times to all enemies in a cross-shaped area around the user. Cast Time cannot be interrupted, and each cast drains 20% of current HP.

===Notes===
*The effect of this skill lasts for 0.9 seconds, during which time the user is immobilized.
*This skill strikes between 1 and 3 times, depending highly on position and movement of enemy/enemies.
*When one or more monsters are on a single cell of this skill, the number of hits are reduced by 1 per monster, to a minimum of one hit to one monster.
*This skill does not work when wearing a shield with {{item|id=4128 '''Golden Thiefbug Card'''}}.
*The [[Holy]] property is applied at the end of calculations, which means the following: [[Holy]] × Weapon property for the physical portion, and [[Neutral]] × [[Holy]] property for the magic portion.
*Though a Hybrid skill, it seems to scale far better with [[Stats#INT|INT]] as the main stat and high Weapon Attack better than having high [[Stats#STR|STR]] and low [[Stats#INT|INT]] (Example: 50 STR and 90 INT with a decently high Weapon Attack damage will hit harder than 90 STR and 50 INT with the same weapon).
*[[DEF|Defense]] values are not applied to this skill in the same way as they are applied to other skills. It appears that [[DEF#Hard DEF|Hard Defense]] is subtracted off the final damage value instead of reducing damage by a percent, basically treating it as [[DEF#Soft_DEF|Soft Defense]].
*The overall damage (including the magic portion) is strangely affected by long-ranged modifiers such as {{item|id=1016 Archer Skeleton Card}}.

Plants a bullet on a targeted location that will explode when triggered, inflicting ranged [[ATK|physical damage]]. The effect varies according to the type of bullet used.

===Notes===
*These mines differ from traps as they may be placed under players or [[monster]]s.
*Cards will affect the damage of the bullet.
*Card effects like {{item |id=4399 '''Memory of Thanatos Card'''}} work with this skill.
*Damage is calculated when somebody steps on the mine, this means that when the weapon is tagged, card effects like {{item|id=4035 Hydra}} and {{item|id=4399 '''Memory of Thanatos'''}} will work even if it wasn't the weapon the bullet was planted with.
*The activation and damage of this skill are blocked by [[Magnetic Earth]].
*If this skill is used on a [[Hiding|hidden]] target, the mine will explode (it assumes that a player or [[monster]] is occupying the cell) but no damage will be inflicted to the [[Hiding|hidden]] target. 
*[[Pneuma]] also blocks damage given by mines and triggers the explosion.
*Up to 25 mines can be active on screen.
*When the user dies, the mines will not be removed from the screen but will still trigger when somebody walks over them, no damage will be dealt as well.

'''Hell Plant''' (Alt: ''Hell's Plant'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Geneticist]].

==Effect==

Attach a cannibal plant to the user, which will inflict damage to 5x5 area around the user every 0.3 second. Its damage is affected by [[Summon Flora]] and each cast consumes a {{item |id=7137 Plant Bottle}}.

===Notes===
*The damage is determined at the time of applying the buff, meaning multiplier will persist even after buffs like Runaway Magic has expired.
*The skill element can be changed by using converters and such.
*The skill is affected by defense and flee.
*The skill will not trigger reflect damage.
*The skill will not trigger drain effect, such as Hunterfly card or [[Blood Sucker]].
*The skill will trigger gain HP/SP effect, such as Catherina Von Blood.
*The skill will still do damage in [[Invisibility]], [[Cloaking]] and or sitting down.
*The skill will not do damage when the player is in [[Hiding]], [[Stealth]] or over 90% overweight, .

'''Hindsight''' (Alt: ''Auto Spell'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Sage]] and [[Scholar]].
==Effect==
Allows to {{Tooltip|autocast|To cast a skill automatically under certain conditions}} a spell while physically attacking enemies temporarily. Spells triggered by this skill only consume 2/3 of their SP Cost, but they cannot be cast through this skill if they have not yet learned.

===Notes===
*The physical attacks do not have to hit the target to engage the selected skill.
*When this skill is executed, a window will appear from which the user can select which skill to use when the autocast happens.
*The skill is cast after the physical attack that activates it and is independent of the user's condition. For example, it will still activate while the user is [[Status Effects#Silence|silenced]].
*The user is able to select any of the skills obtained from the current level available and also those of lower levels.
*Levels of autocasted spells is the half of Hindsight level. If autocasted spells has lower level than half of Hindsight levels, actual skill level will be autocasted instead.
*When the user is linked to the [[Sage Spirit]], the Bolts will always come down at the maximum level learned by the user.
*Spells triggered by this skill do not have any [[Skills#Cast Time|cast time]], but do have [[Skills#Cast Delay|cast delay]]. Cast delays, however, will not prevent bolts from being triggered via this skill. As a result, it is possible to fire off bolts very quickly.
*The skills will all retain their special effects on their targets; [[Frost Diver]] will freeze, [[Fire Ball]] will have splash damage, etc.
*Misses anyone inside [[Blinding Mist]].
*Can be combined with other [[autocast]] equipment. However, unlike this skill, most autocast effects require the user not to miss attacks to trigger them.

==Known Bugs==
*If the caster does not have any skill learned for the current level of this skill (This skill at level 1 can only use [[Napalm Beat]]), no popup menu will appear.
*When the caster does not select any skill from the popup menu (even pressing cancel), no skills can be executed anymore unless the player changes map or relogs.

==History==
{{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Hindsight&oldid=47406 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates.

==Changelog==
*{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}}
**Autocast level changed.
***Old: The Bolt skills will vary in level from level 1 to 3. The level 1 version will occur 50% of the time, level 2 35%, and level 3 at 15%.
***New: Levels of autocasted spells is the half of Hindsight level. If autocasted spells has lower level than half of Hindsight levels, actual skill level will be autocasted instead.
**Autocast chance changed.
***Old: 7% - 25%
***New: (Skill Level x 2)%
**Usable skills changed.
***Old: Napalm Beat, Fire Bolt, Cold Bolt, Lightning Bolt, Soul Strike, Fire Ball, Frost Diver
***New: Fire Bolt, Cold Bolt, Lightning Bolt, Soul Strike, Fire Ball, Earth Spike, Frost Diver, Thunderstorm, Heaven's Drive

'''Ice Trap''' (Alt: ''Ice Bound Trap'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

== Effect==
A maximum of 2 trap can be placed at once. When the trap activates, it deals damage in a 5x5 area and causes [[Freezing]] status. Freezing will last for 20 seconds on afflicted targets, and the duration cannot be reduced by the target's stats. Increased skill level increases the chance to status.  To use the skill you need 1 Special Alloy Trap. Cause water element damage.

 '''Damage Formula''' = ATK 100% + [{(Ice Trap Skill Level x Caster’s DEX) + (INT x 5)} x (1.5 + Caster’s Base Level / 100)] x {(Trap Research Skill Level x 20) / 100}

=== Notes ===
* This trap can be placed under players and monsters.
* This trap will yield 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]].
* This trap has a 3x3 activation area and can only activate 0.5s after it has been placed.
* This trap's activation cannot be avoided with [[Hover]].
* This trap takes 1s to disappear once activated.
* This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]].
* This trap can be activated by [[Detonator]].
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].
* This trap will bypass [[Guard]], [[Parry]] and [[Weapon Blocking]].
* This trap can activate effects like Hunter Fly Card, Rideword Hat and etc.
* The Damage is split into 2 portions, ATK portion and everything else will be called that stat portion.
* Stat portion will bypass [[DEF]] and [[Flee]].
* Stat portion bypass [[Race]], [[Element]] and [[Size]] damage effects like Thara Frog, Tatacho and Ogretooth Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]].
* Stat portion bypass [[Element]] resistance effects like Hode Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]].
* ATK portion is affected by [[DEF]] and [[Flee]].
* ATK portion is affected by [[Race]], [[Element]] and [[Size]] damage effects like Thara Frog, Tatacho and Ogretooth Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]].
* ATK portion is affected by [[Element]] resistance effects like Hode Card in [[PvP]] and [[WoE]].
* ATK portion is affected by [[Element]] which can be used to do bonus damage but is still considered [[Neutral]] when used against Ghost type targets.

== General Trap information ==
* Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in WoE.
* Traps occupy 1 cell.
* Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to another Trap.
* Traps can be activated by and will affect both allies and enemies in [[PVP]] and [[WoE]].
* Traps will not activate if the caster is under the effect of [[Manhole]].
* Traps cannot be activated by the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that charmed the caster with [[Siren's Voice]].
* [[Siren's Voice]] protects the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] from traps of charmed trappers.
* Traps can be removed by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]].
* Trap damage is considered [[Melee]] and will be blocked by [[Safety Wall]].
* Trap damage is reflected back to the caster by [[Shield Reflect]] and {{item |id= 2524 Valkyrian Manteau}}.
* Damage traps gains "Killed by a melee attack" effects like {{item|id=4279 Earth Deleter Card}}.
* Damage traps gains "Each attack has chance of" effects like {{item|id=4411 Vanberk Card}}.
* Damage traps gains [[SP]] Drain/Gain effects like {{item|id=1234 Moonlight Dagger}} or {{item|id=4281 Zipper Bear Card}}.

'''Ice Wall''' (Alt: ''Ice Wall'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Wizard]], [[High Wizard]] and [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|expanded]] [[Super Novice]].
==Effect==
Creates a wall of ice in a targeted location to impede movement until its durability wears off or expires.
