===Notes===
*The durability decreases by 50 each second and can be reduced further by attacking it.
*A seemingly unlimited number of monsters can be trapped within the same ice wall. When multiple monsters are following the player, placing an ice wall to immobilize the first monster in line usually result in the other monsters following right into the wall and getting immobilized too.
*When a monster is trapped by an ice wall, it is still vulnerable by targeted skills and physical attacks. A player standing in front of and 1 cell away from the ice wall will be able to attack the monster and completely avoid being hit by it, if the monster's attack range is no greater than 1 cell.
*Because cells affected by ice wall become "snipable wall" type, [[:Category:AoE Skills|area skills]] used ''after'' ice walls are in place do not directly hit those cells. Although several skills —most notably (but not limited to) [[Storm Gust]], [[Meteor Storm]] and [[Lord of Vermilion]]— sometimes appear to hit monsters in ice wall, this is a result of splash damage to adjacent non-walled cells and not any other special property of these skills. Note that casting this skill on a cell after an area skill has already been used on it does not stop the effect of the area skill; this skill must be cast before the area akill in order to have any protective use.
*Monsters with [[Teleport]] usually activate it a few moments after getting hit if they are trapped by an ice wall. Some monsters may not teleport if the player is standing within its casting range. 
*Players don't get immobilized by an ice wall unless they are completely surrounded by it. A player or monster surrounded by a 3x3 cell area of this skill is still vulnerable to targeted skills and ranged attacks, but is no longer vulnerable to area skills including [[Storm Gust]], [[Meteor Storm]] and [[Lord of Vermilion]].
*The ice wall is [[Neutral]] property and can be damaged by regular attacks (melee or ranged), single target skills and [[Sightrasher]]. Skills and weapons with splash-damage effect ([[Napalm Vulcan]], [[Hunter]]'s [[Blitz Beat]]) will damage surrounding ice walls even when targeting trapped players or monsters within it.
*This skill is disabled in [[War of Emperium|WoE]] but it does work in [[PvP]].
*This skill can be used to [[release]] unwanted stored spells in fields, dungeons, and towns by selecting it as a target.
*In addition to Level 1 [[Frost Diver]] and Level 1 [[Stone Curse]], [[Super Novice]]s also have a prerequisite of doing the [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|Expansion Quest]]. [[Wizard]]s only require the forementioned skills.
*This skill is disabled in [[Lighthalzen#Somatology_Laboratory_Dungeon|Lighthalzen Dungeon]] 5 (Nightmare Biolab).

==Applications==
*This skill can be used to immobilize monsters traveling from West to East and from South to North (using the mini-map as a reference). The easiest way to pull this off is having an ice wall placed right on the ground cell the [[monster]] is currently walking on. A single ice wall is enough to immobilize a monster, but a second ice wall must be placed adjacent to and behind the first to effectively trap the monster and prevent it from escaping and attacking other players. Placing the second ice wall is also useful to cancel the knock-back feature of [[Jupitel Thunder]] and [[Storm Gust]].

'''Intensification''' (Alt: ''Intense Telekinesis'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Warlock]].
==Effect==
Places a temporary buff on the user that increases [[Ghost]] property [[MATK|Magic Damage]], shortens their [[Skills#Cast Time|Variable Cast Time]], and reduces their SP Cost.

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!Damage Increase!!VCT Decrease!!SP Cost Decrease!!SP Cost

|-

|-
!5

|}

===Notes===
*SP Cost decrease only applies for [[Ghost]] property spells while Variable Cast Time shortening works for all spells with the exception of [[Mystical Amplification]], as it does not have Variable Cast Time.
*The damage increase acts as a final damage multiplier. At Level 5, it triples [[Ghost]] property magic damage, or a 200% increase. This is separate of Elvira card or similar ghost property boosts.
*This skill was implemented among other skills with the Lv175/60 expansion.
*The Variable Cast Time reduction strangely counts as [[Skills#Calculation|Gear Variable Cast Time Reduction]] instead of [[Skills#Calculation|Skill Variable Cast Time Reduction]].
**This means it stacks additively with equips like {{item|id=19139 Survivor's Orb}} or {{item|id=4145 Beelzebub Card}}, but multiplies with skills & equips such as [[Suffragium]] or {{item|id=1646 La'cryma Stick[2]}}.

'''Kyrie Eleison''' (Alt: ''Kyrie Eleison'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Priest]] and [[High Priest]].
==Effect==
Creates a protective barrier on a single target that blocks every form of [[ATK|physical damage]] until its durability wears off or expires. Its durability is a portion of the target's [[Max HP]]. This skill '''CAN''' be used in conjunction with [[Assumptio]] since the May 1 Skill Rebalance Update on iRO.

===Notes===
*[[Holy Light]] will immediately cancel the barrier on the targeted player.
*[[DEF |Armor DEF]] and reductions decrease the damage Kyrie Eleison takes.
*Order of which defensive mechanic is calculated first is:
**[[Perfect Dodge]] > [[Flee]] > [[Safety Wall]] > Kyrie Eleison > [[Pneuma]]
***For example, [[Perfect Dodge|perfectly dodged]] and missed attacks will not reduce the number of hits the barrier can withstand.
***If inside a [[Safety Wall]], [[Safety Wall]] will absorb the damage first until broken before damage reduces Kyrie Eleison.

==Applications==
*For practical purposes, it is recommended to learn an even numbered level of this skill in order to maximize the number of hits blocked per skill point used.

==Etymology==
*''Kyrie Eleison'' is a Greek phrase means "Lord, have mercy".

'''Lava Slide''' (Alt: ''Lava Slide'') is a [[Homunculus S]] exclusive offensive skill available to [[Dieter]].
==Effect==
Commands Dieter to place a lava slide in a set area around the targeted location that will inflict [[Fire]] property [[ATK|Physical Damage]] every 2 seconds. Each hit has a chance of leaving enemies [[Status Effects#Burning|burning]].

===Notes===
*Only one instance of this skill can be active at a time.
*The skill ends when 5 separate hit attempts have been dealt.
**The moment an enemy enters the [[Area of Effect]] of this skill, it is considered for a hit attempt.
**Attempts that miss, or fail due to being blocked or the target being out of line of sight, still count toward the skill's five-attempt limit.
*This skill inflicts Ranged Damage if the target is more than 4 cells away from [[Dieter]], so it can be blocked by [[Pneuma]]. Otherwise it inflicts Melee Damage which can be blocked by [[Safety Wall]] instead.
*The damage is part [[Fire]] property and part [[Non-elemental damage|Null]] property.
*Only targets in [[Dieter]]'s line of sight can be successfully hit.
*Every hit attempt on an enemy makes them ineligible for further attempts for two seconds. Therefore, it is not possible for a target to be hit by more than one instance of this skill at the same time. In other words, multiple instances of this skill do not stack.
*If an enemy is in the [[Area of Effect]] of multiple instances of this skill, the instance with the lowest ID number has priority. Even if the instance with the highest priority misses, the target is nonetheless granted the two-second immunity and cannot be hit by any other instance of this skill during this time.
*After an instance of this skill has made five hit attempts, it will expire at the end of the current "frame"; however, it will continue to process all remaining eligible and in-range targets in the current frame. Thus, one instance of this skill can hit more than five enemies before it disappears.
*If even one cell of the [[Area of Effect]] is swept (for example by [[Ganbantein]] or [[Crazy Vines]]), the entire instance disappears.
*[[Magnetic Earth]] does not remove this skill unless it covers the cell on which the skill was cast. While this skill cannot be cast over [[Magnetic Earth]], it can be centered on a nearby unprotected cell to splash targets near the edge.

==Known Bugs==
*A homunculus can have more than one instance of this skill active at once. If those instances then disappear before another one can be cast, the homunculus may become bugged and unable to cast any more instances of this skill until it is [[vaporize]]d and [[Call Homunculus|resummoned]].

'''Left Hand Mastery''' (Alt: ''Left Hand Mastery'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class passive skill available as [[Kagerou]] and [[Oboro]].

Restores your left-hand ATK, which decreases when you're equipped with two weapons.

By default, Kagerou and Oboro can dual wield weapons. Doing so incurs a penalty when performing a close range melee attack (also known as an auto-attack). This penalty can be negated by virtue of the left and right hand mastery skills. In the case of the right hand, the damage can be improved beyond its normal amount.

'''Lex Aeterna''' (Alt: ''Lex Aeterna'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Priest]] and [[High Priest]].
==Effect==
Weakens a single target so it can take double damage from the next incoming attack. [[Heal]]ing, misses, [[Status Effects|status effects]] and the retaliation from [[Shield Reflect]] do not trigger the effect.

===Notes===
*This skill is removed if the proceeding attack is blocked by [[Guard]], [[Parry]], or [[Kaupe]], even if no damage was received.
*If an offensive skill does multiple hits with individual damage each ([[Water Ball]], [[Storm Gust]], etc.), only the first hit will be affected by this skill. However, if these hits are in a damage bundle ([[Cold Bolt]], [[Sonic Blow]], etc. where a large yellow number shows the total damage), the whole damage will be affected by this skill.
*Can not be cast on a [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] or [[Status Effects#Stone|petrified]] target. It can, however, be cast during the first stage of [[Stone Curse]], before the target becomes fully [[Status Effects#Stone|petrified]]. 

==Etymology==
*''Lex Aeterna'' is Latin for "eternal law."

'''Lord of Vermilion''' (Alt: ''Lord of Vermilion'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Wizard]] and [[High Wizard]].
==Effect==
Calls forth destructive bolts from the skies upon a targeted location that will inflict [[Wind]] property [[MATK|magic damage]] to all enemies within its area of effect. It has a chance of leaving enemies [[Status Effects#Blind|blind]].

===Notes===
*The damage is inflicted in a bundle of 20 hits. This only affects the divisibility of their damage, which are rounded down.
*This skill does not stack with other instances of this skill; two simultaneous instances in one location have no more effect than just one. Anything hit by this skill is temporarily immune to the skill for 0.5 second. The mechanism is similar to that of [[Storm Gust]] and [[Priest]]'s [[Magnus Exorcismus]].

==Applications==
*This is one of the [[Wizard]]'s three main [[Area of Effect|area]] skills. As [[Wind]] property, it can do extensive damage to [[Water]] property or [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] enemies. This skill inflicts less damage than [[Storm Gust]] or [[Meteor Storm]], but it inflicts consistent damage to all targets within the area (unlike [[Meteor Storm]]) and also has a good chance of inflicting the [[Status Effects#Blind|Blind]] status. The area is also considerably larger than [[Storm Gust]], not counting its splash nature. Unlike [[Storm Gust]], this skill does not hit a target unless it is in the caster's line of sight.
*Unlike many other [[Wizard]] skills, this skill has lower cast time as its level increases. The chance to [[Status Effects#Blind|blind]] and damage also increases with level, but the number of sub-hits remain the same.
*This skill is useful for hit-locking enemies during [[War of Emperium]], making them have trouble moving from one cell to another.

'''Magenta Trap''' (Alt: ''Magenta Trap'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

== Effect ==
A maximum of 1 trap can be placed at once. Permanently changes the monster that steps on this trap and any monster in a 5x5 area around this trap to [[Fire]] Element. Does not affect boss type monsters or players, and consumes one Red Blood and a Special Alloy Trap.  
 
== Information == 
* This trap can be placed under players and monsters.
* This trap will yield only 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]].
* This trap has a 3x3 activation area and can only activate 0.5s after it has been placed.
* This trap disappears instantly once activated.
* This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]].
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].

== General Trap information ==
* Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in WoE.
* Traps occupy 1 cell.
* Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to another Trap.
* Traps will not activate if the caster is under the effect of [[Manhole]].

'''Magic Rod''' (Alt: ''Magic Rod'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Sage]] and [[Scholar]].
==Effect==
Absorbs incoming magic spells and replenishes SP from a portion of their SP Cost. Only '''single target magic spells''' can be absorbed by this skill. If an enemy casts [[Spell Breaker]] and is countered by this skill, the user of this skill will absorb 20% of the enemy's [[Max SP]].

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!Duration!!SP Absorb
|-
!1
|0.4s||20%
|-
!2
|0.6s||40%
|-
!3
|0.8s||60%
|-
!4
|1.0s||80%
|-
!5
|1.2s||100%
|}

===Notes===
*If [[Energy Coat]] is active, SP will be drained for every hit, even if spells are being absorbed by this skill.

==Applications==
*This skill functions much like [[Knight]]'s [[Counter Attack]] skill. This skill must be used when the incoming spell is expected to strike the user. A successful absorption will repeat the animation of this skill and will replenish SP. The difference to [[Counter Attack]] is, that multiple spells can be absorbed during the duration, instead of a single one.
*It is generally best to execute this skill when the enemy skill's cast bar is nearly full. This works for most skills with a noticeable [[Skills#Cast Time|cast time]]. However, against skills such as [[Frost Diver]], it is simpler to spam the skill over and over.
*Using this skill will cause the player to have a short delay, like any skill. This prevents from walking while spamming this skill despite no cast bar being present.
*When using this skill against [[Water Ball]], every ball is counted as single spell and they can be absorbed for the duration of this skill, replenishing SP multiple times. This skill can even be executed after [[Water Ball]] already started.

It is also calculated into every hit of this skill (this skill, when mastered, will inflict [250% + (20% × 250%)] = 300% [[ATK|physical damage]], but 1/6th of that damage will be of [[Fire]] property that pierces [[DEF|defense]]). *Since some skills are {{tooltip|pseudo-elemental|Even if elemental, Ghost property treats damage as Neutral}}, the 20% of [[Fire]] element bonus is pseudo-elemental too. ==Applications== *This skill is useful for pushing players out of [[Pneuma]], as it position bugs them, unlike [[Bowling Bash]] or [[Brandish Spear]], making it difficult for them to re-[[Pneuma]]. == Description ==

Cast a manhole on the ground, trapping a single target that enters the cell or any adjacent cell. Once trapped, the target cannot use active [[Skills]] or attack. Only buffs and [[Shadow Formation]] can be cast on the target while in this state. A Shadow Chaser may have up to 3 active manholes at any time.

{|class=wikitablec
 ! Level !! Duration !! SP Cost
|-
! 1
|| 5s || 20
|-
! 2
|| 10s || 25
|- 
! 3
|| 15s || 30
|}

The Duration represents a single manhole's time limit to trap a victim. Upon successfully trapping a target, this timer resets, ensuring a maximum amount of capture time.

== Mechanics ==

During this trapped state, the target is effectively removed from gameplay. Any traps placed beneath a target in Manhole will only take effect once they are released. The only method to damage a player in this state is through [[Shadow Formation]], or status effects such as [[Burning]], which still work during this duration. Other effects, including [[Reflect Damage]] or [[Gravitational Field]], will not deal damage.

A manhole cannot be cast directly under a target, but can be placed beside one, effectively trapping them instantly. Doing so will also shift the player 1 cell towards the center of the manhole. Manholes can no longer be placed adjacent current manholes, which prevents the "infinite trapping" that used to take place.

==Notes==

* Currently the trap effect only works in PvP/WoE areas.
* Both allies and opponents are affected by Manhole.
* Manholes cannot be placed in towns.
* [[Magnetic Earth]] will remove Manholes, but will not free any trapped targets.
* Manholes are also removed when the user leaves the map.
* Manholed players can still use items as normal.

'''Marionette Control''' (Alt: ''Marionette Control'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Minstrel]] and [[Gypsy]].
==Effect==
Takes control of the soul of a single target and bestows the half of the user's [[Stats|base stats]] to it. However, each of the target's stats cannot exceed 99.

===Notes===
*Despite what the skill name may imply, both the user and the target are still able to move. 
*To cancel the skill, press and hold Shift and use this skill on any target, and the skill will be canceled.
*The user's [[Max HP]] will be decreased by 1,000 until this skill is canceled.
*Both the user and the target must be within 8 cells of each other, or this skill will wear off.
*[[Bard]] and [[Dancer]] classes cannot be targeted by this skill.
*While this skill is active, the user cannot use any other skills.
*If the target logs out, the effects of this skill stay on the user, but does not affect the target.

==Known Bugs & Glitches==
*Casting this skill and then leaving the party is possible. The effects will stay on both the target and the user.
*Any supportive skills or equipment that boost [[stats]] ([[Blessing]], {{item|id=2285 Apple of Archer}}) will not be counted if worn while this skill is cast. However, if worn after this skill is casted, the stats are added in.

'''Martyr's Reckoning''' (Alt: ''Sacrifice'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Paladin]].
==Effect==
Allows to inflict [[Neutral]] property special damage for the next five normal attacks at cost of 9% of the user's [[Max HP]] each. These hits pierce [[DEF|defense]] and ignore the accuracy check.

===Notes===
*Relogging or using [[Battle Chant]] will cancel this skill.
*Although the damage from this skill is physical, [[ATK|Attack]] does not affect the damage.
*It can still be [[Perfect Dodge|dodged perfectly]].
*Every normal attack counts for this skill, whether it lands or not.
*The damage bonus from [[Magnum Break]] does increase the damage of this skill, but it is still forced to [[Neutral]] property.
*{{item|id=2644 The Sign}} does increase the damage of this skill, but the {{item|id=2720 Medal of Honor (Swordman)}} only increases the damage from the [[Max HP]] bonus.
*Although the damage is applied to normal attacks, it is still affected by the skill damage reduction from the [[War of Emperium]] and [[Battlegrounds]].
*Other skills are usable, but they're unaffected by this skill.
*This skill has higher priority over any other effects, such as [[Royal Guard]]'s [[Exceed Break]].
*The {{monster|id=1288 Emperium}} is unaffected by this skill.
*If this skill is used outside of [[Classical Pluck]], this effect will function within it.
*The special effect of {{item|id=1230 Ice}} {{item|id=13017 Pick}} does not work with this skill.
*{{item|id=4147 '''Baphomet Card'''}} does not work with this skill.
*If this skill is used and then [[Gloria Domini]] is used, this skill can still be used during the delay of [[Gloria Domini]].

'''Maze Trap''' (Alt: ''Maize Trap'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

A maximum of 1 trap can be placed at once. Permanently changes the monster that steps on this trap and any monster in a 5x5 area around this trap to [[Earth]] Element. Does not affect boss type monsters or players, and consumes one Green Live and a Special Alloy Trap.

* This trap can be placed under players and monsters.
* This trap will yield only 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]].

* This trap disappears instantly once activated.
* This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]].
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].
* Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in WoE.
* Traps occupy 1 cell.

'''Mental Charge''' (Alt: ''Mental Change'') is a Homunculus exclusive active skill available to [[Lif]].

==Effect==
Commands [[Lif]] to temporarily swap her mental power, causing her attacks use [[MATK]] instead [[ATK]]. This skill also increases [[Lif]]'s [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] by 30 and [[Stats#INT|INT]] by 20 per skill level. Upon skill effect end, [[Lif]]'s HP and SP are reduced to 10.

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!VIT Boost!!INT Boost!!Duration!!Cooldown
|-
!1
|30||20||1m||10m
|-
!2
|60||40||3m||15m
|-
!3
|90||60||5m||20m
|}

===Notes===
*Despite the official description, this skill does not swap [[Lif]]'s [[Max SP]] to [[Max HP]], and her HP and SP aren't fully restored upon activating it.
*[[Vaporize|Vaporizing]] [[Lif]] removes the effects of this skill, but it doesn't cause her HP and SP to be reduced to 10, effectively preventing it.
*The [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] and [[Stats#INT|INT]] bonuses do not affect [[Lif]]'s [[Max HP]], [[Max SP]] or [[Aid Potion]]'s healing value, hence, the added [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] affects [[DEF#Soft DEF|soft defense]] only. However, it does affect [[Healing Hands]]' healing value.
*Due to the Homunculi's stat formula, the effect on [[Lif]]'s [[MATK]] has been severely diminished (increases [[MATK]] by up to 80 as result). However, the effect on [[Lif]]'s [[DEF#Soft DEF|soft defense]] was improved (increases [[DEF#Soft DEF|Soft DEF]] by up to 180 as result).

==Known Bugs==
*[[Lif]]'s standard attacks are not using [[MATK]].

'''Meteor Storm''' (Alt: ''Meteor Storm'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Wizard]] and [[High Wizard]].
==Effect==
Calls forth meteors from the skies that randomly fall within its area of effect around the targeted location. Each meteor will inflict 125% [[Fire]] property [[MATK|magic damage]] each hit to all enemies in a 7x7 area around each meteor. It has a chance of leaving enemies [[Status Effects#Stun|stunned]].

===Notes===
*Despite the animation, all damage of each meteor is connected in one single bundle.
*Meteors that fall on the border of the targeted area cause damage 6 cells beyond the target area border, giving this skill the potential to damage enemies in a 13x13 area.
*Meteors that fall on "null" cells of the map will still count against the total number of meteors that are to fall, while not actually hitting any enemies.
*Unlike the two other [[Area of Effect|area]] skills, [[Storm Gust]] and [[Lord of Vermillion]], this skill stacks; multiple casts will still continue to drop meteors, meaning that multiple [[Wizard]]s can be casting more instances of this skill at the same location without loss of efficiency.

==Applications==
*This is one of the [[Wizard]]'s three main [[Area of Effect|area]] skills. As [[Fire]] property, it can do extensive damage to [[Undead]] and [[Earth]] property enemies. The additional chance to [[Status Effects#Stun|Stun]] gives it extra use in [[PvP]] scenarios, and so does its ability to be stacked; multiple instances of this skill can be cast and constantly impacting the same area, unlike [[Storm Gust]] and [[Lord of Vermilion]]. Many Wizards will have either this skill or [[Lord of Vermilion]]. Unlike [[Storm Gust]], meteors do not hit a target unless the target is in the caster's line of sight when the meteor lands.
*Although powerful, this skill inflicts less consistent damage. Which targets are actually hit by the meteors depends on where the meteors themselves hit. It is possible to cast this skill and fail to do any damage at all. Higher levels deliver more meteors, providing a more reliable damage source if one intends to use it often.
*Enemies toward the center of the casting circle will tend to get hit by the most meteors.

'''Change to Undead Property''' (Alt: ''Change Undead'') is an active skill exclusive to [[monster]]s.
==Effect==
Changes the target's property to [[Undead]]. During this state, the player receives all the qualities of being Undead property, such as vulnerability to [[Heal]] and [[Sanctuary]] (or immunity to them in a non-PvP zone), and taking extra damage from [[Holy]] and [[Fire]] property attacks while being immune to Undead, [[Shadow]], and [[Poison]] property attacks. 

===Notes===
* The player appears in a greenish hue when afflicted by the Undead status.
* Prior to the update iRO received on 16 February 2007, this status effect was visible to everyone except the player affected by this skill.
* The player can't use supportive spells such as [[Increase AGI]] and [[Blessing]] on itself or others.
* [[Increase AGI]] and [[Blessing]] do 1 damage to the player when cast by others. Despite this, they can not be copied by a [[Rogue]] class with [[Intimidate]].
* [[Increase AGI]] and [[Blessing]] and potentially other buffs are removed as soon as this status takes effect.

* When affected by this status effect, it shows the [[Gloria]] status icon.

===Tips===
*{{item | id=12475 Cure Free}} can undo the effect.
*Re-logging gets rid of the status.
* Can be prevented by wearing {{item|id=4141 Undead}} property armor.

title: NPC SUMMONSLAVE
wikitext:
== Description ==
[[Image:Npc_summonslave.gif|frame|Summon Slave]]

* Supportive skill
* Levels: 1

Creates monsters that are bound to the skill's caster. Slave monsters have the following characteristics:

# The slaves do not move by themselves. They generally follow their master around when it moves. If their master is out of range, the slaves will stand still.
# The slaves will attack whoever their master is targetting; however, if the master changes targets, the slaves will still continue to attack the original target. If that target dies or leaves their sight range, they will then change targets to whoever their master is attacking.
# If the master is not attacking anybody, or if their master is out of range, they will stand around doing nothing. However, if attacked, they will attack back.
# If the master uses Teleport, the slaves will teleport along with it.
# When the master dies, the slaves will also die. The slaves will yield no experience or drops from dying this way.
# The slaves will respond to [[NPC CALLSLAVE|Call Slave]].
# The slaves' movement speed is equivalent to the master's movement speed at the time of summoning.

Note that points 1, 2, and 3 do not seem to apply to all monsters; some have seemingly independent slaves that move around and attack on their own free will. However, they still die or teleport when their master does.

Some monsters spawn with slaves with them already.

== See also ==

Places a 5x5 area around the user that protects entities from Ranged Physical Damage and increases [[DEF|Physical]] and [[MDEF|Magic Defense]]. wikitext: {{Skill Info |class=Swordman |class2=Super Novice |class3=Mercenary |type=Offensive |levels=10, fixed |prereqs=([[Swordman]] & [[Super Novice]]) [[Bash]] Lv. 5 |spcost=30 |hpcost=20 ~ 16 |delay=2 seconds |target=Self |range=Melee |area=5x5 |knock=2 |element=Fire }} '''Magnum Break''' (Alt: ''Magnum Break'') is a 1st class offensive skill available as [[Swordman]], [[Super Novice]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]]. ==Effect== Produces a fire blast from the user to inflict [[Fire]] property [[ATK|physical damage]] to all enemies in a 5x5 [[Area of Effect|area]] around the user and push them 2 cells backwards. This skill also adds 20% [[Fire]] property damage to all attacks for 10 seconds. Each cast drains a small amount of HP. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Damage (ATK)!!HIT Bonus!!HP Cost |- !1 |120%||10%||rowspan=2|20 |- !2 |140%||20% |- !3 |160%||30%||rowspan=2|19 |- !4 |180%||40% |- !5 |200%||50%||rowspan=2|18 |- !6 |220%||60% |- !7 |240%||70%||rowspan=2|17 |- !8 |260%||80% |- !9 |280%||90%||rowspan=2|16 |- !10 |300%||100% |} ===Notes=== * It is a common misconception that this skill endows weapons with the [[Fire]] property during its 10-second buff. In actuality, this skill adds an additional 20% [[Fire]] property damage on top of all normal attacks for ten seconds. This means that if the user does a [[Neutral]] property attack, only the 20% [[Fire]] property damage will be affected by the opponent's [[Element]]. *The [[Fire]] property damage bonus pierces [[DEF|defense]]. It is also calculated into every hit of this skill (this skill, when mastered, will inflict [250% + (20% × 250%)] = 300% [[ATK|physical damage]], but 1/6th of that damage will be of [[Fire]] property that pierces [[DEF|defense]]). *Since some skills are {{tooltip|pseudo-elemental|Even if elemental, Ghost property treats damage as Neutral}}, the 20% of [[Fire]] element bonus is pseudo-elemental too. ==Applications== *This skill is useful for pushing players out of [[Pneuma]], as it position bugs them, unlike [[Bowling Bash]] or [[Brandish Spear]], making it difficult for them to re-[[Pneuma]]. This is helpful for aiding party members with ranged attacks, or following up with an attack such as [[Clashing Spiral]] or [[Acid Bomb]]. *The 10-second buff is '''not''' an effective tool for bypassing {{item |id=4047 Ghostring carded}} [[armor]], even if the user's weapon is not [[Neutral]] property. [[Aspersio]], [[scroll]]s, endows, [[Enchant Poison]], or {{item |id=12020 Cursed Water}} are far better methods. *Because [[Card Reference#Status Effects|statuses from cards]] or weapons can be transferred through this skill, it can be a mean of inflicting many players at once with statuses. While [[Brandish Spear]] has more range and thereby can inflict more people with statuses in precast lines, {{item |id=1225 Mailbreakers}} and {{item |id=1224 Swordbreakers}} can be used with this skill. Although, [[Bowling Bash]] can also have more range when its "bowling" effect works. *Many [[Priest]]s or other classes also use this skill in either [[PvP]] or [[War of Emperium|WoE]] to inflict [[Status Effects|statuses]], such as with a {{item |id=1531 Wrench}}. ==External== ===Bestowed from=== *{{Item|id=4084 Marine Sphere Card}} - Lv. 3 *{{Item|id=4305 '''Turtle General Card'''}} - Lv. 10; Autocast when attacking *{{item|id=20806 Magnum Break Amistr Bag}} - Level 1; Usable *{{item|id=28438 Fairy Leaf Powder}} - Level 3; Usable {{Navbox Swordman}} {{Navbox SuperNovice}}

'''Ominous Moonlight''' (Alt: ''Akaitsuki'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Oboro]].

== Effect ==
Changes HP recover skills into damage skills for a certain period of time.
When receiving a HP recovery skill, it receives damage of half the recovery rate instead of being healed therefore, a target expected to be healed by 100 HP receives 50 HP damage.

*[[Acolyte]] : [[Heal]]
*[[Priest]] : [[Sanctuary]]
*[[Arch Bishop]] : [[High Heal]] / [[Renovatio]]
*[[Bard]] : [[Song of Lutie]]
*[[Sorcerer]] : [[Warmer]]
If healed by any of the skills above and has the Ominous Crescent debuff, the target receives damage instead of being healed.
Also, with the debuff, target does not auto-recover.

'''Parry''' (Alt: ''Parrying'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Lord Knight]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].
==Effect==
Allows the user to block [[ATK|physical attacks]] with the equipped two-handed sword by chance temporarily.

|}

===Notes===
*The player will be forced to pause momentarily whenever this skill blocks damage. For example, if the user is attacking a monster while this skill is activated and they guard an attack, they will stop attacking the monster for a brief period of time.
*If the user was standing still or running when this skill blocked an attack, they will still be penalized with a short period of time until they can attack or use skills.
*Has the same properties as [[Guard]] for blocking damage, such as how an attack following [[Lex Aeterna]] will remove its effect if blocked. 
*If this skill blocks an attack while its user is casting an interruptible skill, the skill will be interrupted.
*If this skill blocks an attack while the user is running, they will appear to stop quickly while the blocking animation plays, causing awful position lag. They are not actually stopped: the flinch caused from this skill blocking an attack stops a player from being able to attack for a short time, but does not immobilize them even if it appears so.
*This skill will not block [[High Speed Cart Ram]], [[Soul Destroyer]] or [[Acid Bomb]] at all.
*This skill works even if a player is under the effect of status such as [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] or [[Status Effects#Stone|stone cursed]].

==Applications==
*It is situational and up to the user to decide whether they feel a 50% chance to block entire physical attacks (and being able to use [[Two Hand Quicken]]) is better than wearing a shield (allowing them to have more defense and utilize items like cards that [[Card Reference#By race|always give 30% less damage from certain races]]). If [[Guillotine Fist]] will inflict 24,000 damage before shield cards, they could possibly survive with a {{item|id=4058 Cranial Shield}} (30% less damage taken from [[Demi Human]]s). However, if Guillotine Fist inflicted 40,000 damage, a Cranial Shield would likely not save them. This skill will have a chance to, though.
*Skills requiring a [[Spear]] can not be used simultaneously with this skill. However, a user who attacks primarily with [[Spear]] is not necessarily discouraged to learn this skill.
*Mobbing with this skill active can be annoying since the character pauses every time the animation of this skill plays from successfully blocking an attack (even though the player was not actually hit).
*This skill also benefits those who do not have [[Area of Effect|area]] skills and so level with [[Twohand Quicken]]. Ultimately, learning this skill just for [[PvM]]-reasons is not recommended.

'''Play Dead''' (Alt: ''Trick Dead'') is a game start active skill available as [[Novice]]. This skill can only be learned through a certain quest. Also, if the player has promoted to any other class, this skill is no longer usable upon relogging or map change.
==Effect==
Feigns death to avoid menace of nearby enemies, including boss class monsters and other player races in [[PvP]] environments. This skill can be switched on and off.

===Notes===
*Unlike other evasion skills such as [[Hiding]], no monsters are able to detect a player in this state, including [[Boss Protocol|Bosses]] and [[MVP]]s.
*This skill can be deactivated by [[Sage]]'s [[Dispell]] or [[Swordman]]'s [[Provoke]].
*A player feigning death can still be damaged and killed by the [[Tarot Card of Fate]] skill.
*Area status inflicting skills like [[Hammer Fall]], [[Venom Dust]] and [[NPC WIDEBLEEDING|Bloody Party]] does affect players feigning death.
*When affected by the [[Status Effects#Bleeding|Bleeding]] status, this skill is deactivated upon every HP drain.

'''Pneuma''' (Alt: ''Pneuma'') is a 1<sup>st</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Acolyte]] and [[Super Novice]].
==Effect==
Creates a green cloud on a targeted location that blocks every form of Ranged [[ATK|physical damage]], which includes [[Ammunition|projectiles]] from players. Every offensive skill with a range of 4 or more cells counts as being Ranged. This skill cannot be stacked.

===Notes===
*This skill cannot be cast on an instance of [[Magnetic Earth]] or [[Safety Wall]]. Likewise, [[Safety Wall]] cannot be cast on an instance of this skill.
*Only damage is blocked by this skill. Other effects like [[Status Effects#Stun|Stun]] and [[:Category:Knock Back Skills|knockback]] will still occur. It is therefore possible to use [[Arrow Repel]] to knock a player out of a Pneuma and into harm's way.

==Applications==
*It will be difficult to cast this skill again on the same cell quickly, so it is easier to place 2 Pneumas side-by-side and shift when the time is up. The only delay is in the animation, therefore many Pneumas can be placed to protect many people at once. In a party, remember to place Pneuma on oneself before doing so.
*This skill can be used on monsters in PvM to prevent [[Archer]] and [[Gunslinger]] class characters from attacking the monsters.

'''Provoke''' (Alt: ''Provoke'') is a 1<sup>st</sup> class active skill available as [[Swordman]], [[Super Novice]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].
==Effect==
Attempts to taunt a single target to decrease its [[DEF|physical defense]] at cost of increasing its [[ATK|attack power]].

|}

===Notes===
*Against players, only their [[Def#Soft DEF|soft defense]] is decreased.
*This skill does not affect [[Undead]] property and [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] [[monster]]s.

==Applications==
*This skill is great for freeing monsters/players from ice, so they are hit by more hits of skills like [[Storm Gust]] or so they can escape from the [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] status. 

===PvM===
*This skill can be used to aggravate [[monster]]s without dealing damage to them. This is helpful for tanking low level monsters for other players. 
*Provoking monsters with a higher level of this skill will weaken them considerably, allowing much more damage to be dealt to them, unless the player is leveling with [[DEF|defense]]-piercing or formula-flipping skills or weapons, such as an {{item |id=1230 Ice Pick}}.
*This skill counts as a "hit" (or rude attack) on a [[monster]] that is [[Fiber Lock|fiberlocked]], behind an [[Ice Wall|icewall]], or otherwise can't reach the user (if it is not a [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] or [[Undead]] property [[monster]]), and will cause it to use [[Teleport]]. Due to this, attack-based [[autocast]] equipment such as the {{item |id=13414 Elemental Sword}} has a chance to trigger on the target with every successful use of this skill.

===PvP===
*Although this skill can weaken [[monster]]s considerably, it is often unwise to use it on opponents in [[PvP]]; they will gain an [[ATK]] boost for a minor [[DEF#Soft DEF|soft defense]] drop. However, allies can benefit from it in many ways.
*Provoking players that do not benefit from an [[ATK]] boost with the intent of doing more damage to them may also be unwise if the user or party members would normally deal more damage with an {{item |id=1230 Ice Pick}} or skill/weapon of that type. 
*This skill is a good method for interrupting casts, especially during [[War of Emperium|WoE]] where {{item |id=4077 Phen carded}} [[accessories]] are disabled. '''Provoke''' also works in stopping a [[Sacrifice|sacrificed]] opponent's cast, which would otherwise be uninterruptible. This skill at Level 1 can be used here to conserve SP unless there is a large [[Levels|Level]] difference.
*Note that this skill fails against {{item |id=4141 Evil Druid}} armored players ([[Undead]] property). This can hint for the use of a [[Holy]] or [[Fire]] property weapon/endow for boosted damage.

'''Raging Palm Strike''' (Alt: ''Palm Push Strike'') is a [[transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Champion]].
__TOC__
==Effect==
Slams a single target with a palm strike that will push it 3 cells backwards 1 second later. Requires the user to be in [[Fury]] status.

 '''Damage (ATK)''' = [Base_Damage + (STR x 5)] x ({{tooltip|BaseLv ÷ 100|Lv100 ~ Lv175 <nowiki>=</nowiki> 100% ~ 175%}})%

==Applications==
*Although damage can be prevented by [[Safety Wall]], [[Hiding]], and other means, the knockback effect of this skill will still take place. Therefore, this skill can be used to knock an enemy out of [[Safety Wall]] and then use [[Guillotine Fist]] on it, but any skill used afterward must go off after the knockback takes place, or the target will still be protected by [[Safety Wall]]. Consequently, because the knockback is predictable, [[Safety Wall]] can also be casted on the targeted location before the knockback occurs, ensuring that player does not leave the protection of [[Safety Wall]].
*The direction of knockback is determined by the relative player position ''after'' the 1 second delay. If the user walks past the target after using this skill, the direction of knockback can be controlled by the user, thus making the effects less predictable and more difficult to counter (such as with a preemptive [[Safety Wall]]).

==Notes==
*This skill has an animation delay of about 0.5 seconds, though it might be based on [[ASPD]]. In [[War of Emperium]] or at any opportunity where the knockback effect can be prevented (such as the enemy is against a wall), this means the skill can be used roughly every 0.8 seconds. Because of it and the delay for knockback is 1 second, this skill can be used twice before the knockback effect of the first attack trips, causing the enemy to be pushed back twice in succession.
*A line of sight must be available when this skill activates, otherwise it will inflict no damage.

==History==

'''Redemptio''' (Alt: ''Redemptio'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Priest]] and [[High Priest]]. This skill can only be learned through a certain quest.
==Effect==
Sacrifices the caster to revive all [[party]] members around the caster with 50% of their [[Max HP]]. Afterwards, the caster's HP and SP are dropped to 1 and loses 1% of the required [[Base EXP Chart|base experience]] to the next level. The experience loss is reduced by 0.2% for each party member that has been revived. If there is not enough [[experience]], this skill will fail.

===Notes===
*The [[Skills#Cast Time|Cast Time]] can neither be interrupted nor reduced by [[Stats#DEX|DEX]].
*With 5 or more people, the [[experience]] cost is nullified.
*Characters with maxed [[Levels#Base Level|base level]] still receive experience which can be seen on the Character Select screen. This [[experience]] never decreases due to death, so it should continue to rise as the character obtains [[experience]] as usual. This [[experience]] is used when casting this skill; resurrecting less than five people will reduce the [[experience]] shown in the Character Select screen.
*The [[experience]] required to resurrect is 1% of the 99,999,999 maximum, or equal to 1 million, as a whole; each person resurrected reduces the cost by 200,000 EXP.

'''Relax''' (Alt: ''Tension Relax'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Lord Knight]].
==Effect==
Sits down and relaxes to triple the [[HP Recovery]] rate while the user has no [[Weight Limit|overweight]], otherwise this skill allows [[HP Recovery]] at regular rate.

===Notes===
*This skill does not affect [[SP Recovery]].
*Standing up cancels this skill, whether the user manually stood up or was knocked out of sitting by an attack.

==Applications==
*Someone who does not use [[Healing Items]] while leveling and restores their HP by [[HP Recovery|natural regeneration]] will level faster with this skill. However, it is still quickest to invest in [[Healing Items]] and not have any down-time. Someone moving from using [[Healing Items]] to using this skill will level slower.
*This skill may lower the amount of [[Healing Items]] (HP) or skills used rather than replacing them entirely. This can allow for more of other items to be carried or will increase the amount of time one can level until needing to restock at a [[Kafra|Kafra Storage]] (helpful for areas that cost a lot of [[zeny]] to enter).

'''Reproduce''' (Alt: ''Reproduce'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Shadow Chaser]].

==Effect==
Allows the user to obtain the last skill that was inflicted by the enemy while this skill is active, which does not need to connect in order to be reproduced. Using the skill again will cancel this effect and the user will preserve the newly acquired skill. The level of reproduce affects the level of the skill learned from reproduce's effect. For example: if Level 2 [[Bash]] was used upon the user and he/she has learned Level 8 Reproduce, the user will obtain '''Level 8 Bash''' through this skill. Maintaining this skill active will drain SP.

'''Right Hand Mastery''' (Alt: ''Right Hand Mastery'') is an Expanded 2<sup>nd</sup> class passive skill available as [[Kagerou]] and [[Oboro]].
== Effect ==
Restores your right-hand ATK, which decreases when you're equipped with two weapons. At Levels 4 and 5, it also increases your ATK past the single-wield limit.

By default, [[Kagerou]] and [[Oboro]] can dual wield weapons. Doing so incurs a penalty when performing a close range melee attack (also known as an auto-attack). This penalty can negated by virtue of the left and right hand mastery skills. 

* When auto-attacking with two weapons, the weapon in the right hand inflicts only 70% of its potential damage.
* Each level lessens the penalty.
* At level 3, the penalty is negated.
* At levels 4 and 5, the damage is increased beyond its normal amount.

==Effect==
Temporarily increase your mind and spiritual power.

===Notes===
* The {{Status Icon|name=Fury|link=yes}} status from this skill does not stack with normal [[Fury]]. When this skill expires, the '''Fury''' status will immediately stop, regardless of normal [[Fury]].
* While this skill will not be cancelled by [[Dispel]], the '''Fury''' status will.
* When this skill is cast, the maximum amount of Spirit Spheres is instantly summoned. When this skill expires, the number of Spirit Spheres fall back to a normal maximum of 5.
* Both {{Skill List|id=260|skill=Spiritual Cadence|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=447|skill=Monk Spirit|simple=yes}} bypass the [[SP Recovery]] penalty from the {{Status Icon|name=Fury|link=yes}} status.

==Applications==
* [[Fury]] only requires 5 Spirit Spheres. Having at least 10 Spirit Spheres before casting [[Fury]] allows to use {{Skill List|id=271|skill=Guillotine Fist|simple=yes}} immediately.
* A successful {{Skill List|id=271|skill=Guillotine Fist|simple=yes}} will end the {{Status Icon|name=Fury|link=yes}} status from this skill, but the other effects will still be active. If the player wishes to use [[Fury]] again while the this skill is active, simply activate [[Fury]] normally.

'''Root''' (Alt: ''Blade Stop'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Monk]] and [[Champion]].

==Effect==
Performs a stance that allows the user to "catch" an enemy when they use a normal attack against the user during the Time Frame, starting the "Root" status for both. During this status, only the user can attack, by using a skill that is determined by the level of this skill (unless the enemy is also a [[Monk]] class, see [[{{PAGENAME}}#Notes|Notes]]). This skill only works on regular attacks and each cast uses a [[Spirit Sphere]] whether or not the enemy is caught.
[[Occult Impaction]] and [[Throw Spirit Sphere]] damage is increased by 50% when used against target that user caught with [[Root]].

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!Skill Unlocked!!{{tooltip|Time Frame|The time frame when an enemy can be caught}}
|-
!1
| -||0.5s
|-
!2
|{{Skill Icon|Throw Spirit Sphere}}||0.7s
|- 
!3
|{{Skill Icon|Occult Impaction}}||0.9s
|-
!4
|{{Skill Icon|Raging Quadruple Blow}}||1.1s
|- 
!5
|{{Skill Icon|Guillotine Fist}}||1.3s
|}

===Notes===
*Since this skill is of the [[Monk]] discipline, if the user Roots a [[Monk]] class enemy, then the enemy can also use skills while in Root; which skills are available is determined by each player's level of Root.
*During the Root status, players/monsters will retain all of their original characteristics, ''except'' the inability to move or attack. They can be damaged, attacked, use items or even change gears.
*Rooted players/monsters are also susceptible to effects like knockback (and it will not affect the Root status).
*Root only works from Melee range. It can be used against Ranged attackers, but the user of Root must be within Melee range.
*Can be used on boss monsters but duration is reduced to 2 seconds.

==Applications==
*[[Guillotine Fist]] only requires 1 [[Spirit Sphere]] to be cast in the Root status but still requires the [[Fury]] status.
*It is possible to continue the [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] to [[Raging Thrust]] if the enemy is selected right after Quadruple. This way, it is possible use the folowing combos:
**Root -> [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] -> [[Raging Thrust]]
**Root -> [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] -> [[Raging Thrust]] -> [[Glacier Fist]]
**Root -> [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] -> [[Raging Thrust]] -> [[Chain Crush Combo]]
**Root -> [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] -> [[Raging Thrust]] -> [[Glacier Fist]] -> [[Chain Crush Combo]]
**Root -> [[Raging Quadruple Blow]] -> [[Raging Thrust]] -> [[Chain Crush Combo]] -> [[Guillotine Fist]] (Needs to have 1 [[Spirit Sphere]] after [[Chain Crush Combo]] and be in [[Fury]] status)

==History==

==Changelog==

**3 seconds cooldown added.
**Duration decreased.
***Old: 10 + (Skill Level × 10) seconds 
***New: 10 seconds (2 seconds on boss monsters) at all skill levels 
**Skills can now be used on boss monsters.
**The following skills will deal 50% more damage on target caught with Root.
***[[Occult Impaction]]
***[[Throw Spirit Sphere]]

:''This article is about the [[Crusader]] skill which allows one to take damage for another. For the [[Paladin]] skill where health is traded for increased damage, see [[Martyr's Reckoning]].''
'''Sacrifice''' (Alt: ''Devotion'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Crusader]], [[Paladin]] and some [[Mercenary System|Mercenaries]].
==Effect==
Links to a single target to take all of the damage in its place. This skill only works if the target is within ten [[Levels#Base Level|levels]] of the user.

{|class=wikitablec
!Level!!Link Limit!!Range!!Duration
|-
!1
|1||7c||30s
|-
!2
|2||8c||45s
|-
!3
|3||9c||60s
|-
!4
|4||10c||75s
|-
!5
|5||11c||90s
|}

===Notes===
*[[Crusader]]s cannot be targeted by this skill.
*The damage that the user receives from this skill is affected by the party member's [[DEF|defense]], rather than the user's.
*If a player goes beyond the range of this skill, their link line will graphically disappear. This skill does not deactivate until a player takes damage when out of range of the skill, or the duration of the skill expires.
*When a player is linked to the user, none of their skills can be interrupted by [[ATK|physical]] or [[MATK|magical attacks]] as they are not actually receiving any damage. However, certain skills such as [[Provoke]] and [[Gloria Domini]], bypass this protective effect.
*If the user receives damage that exceeds their remaining HP through this skill, they will die, and any damage exceeding the user's HP does not pass to the original target receiving the damage.
*Certain abilities function through this skill: [[Guard]], [[Shield Reflect]], [[Defending Aura]], and [[autocast]] skills that trigger when taking damage. [[Guard]] works as if the linked target had the skill active, also inducing [[ATK|physical attack]] delay when activated. [[Shield Reflect]] only works on melee skills when applied through this skill. This includes [[Guillotine Fist]], as well as [[Arrow Shower]] cast by a monster. [[Defending Aura]] currently will slow down all linked targets when activated, but only apply a reduced damage reduction compared to the 80% reduction on the user.
* Skills like [[Guard]], [[Shield Reflect]], and [[Defending Aura]] need to be re-cast after casting this skill on a player for their effects to function.
*This skill will prevent the [[Soul Linker]] skill [[Kaite]] from functioning since damage is redirected toward the character using this skill.
*Refreshing this skill (recasting it on a linked target before its duration ends) requires that the number of players currently being linked to the user is at least one less than the limit.
*Using [[King's Grace]] removes this skill from protected party members.

Likewise, [[Pneuma]] cannot be cast on an instance of this skill. *This skill does not protect against [[Status Effects|status effects]] or knock back unless they are side effects of a blocked attack. *Against [[monsters]], this skill blocks all regular attacks, [[:Category:Melee Skills|Melee skills]], and some [[:Category:Ranged Skills|ranged skills]] when used at close range. *This skill will always block at least one hit because the hit that breaks it will be completely absorbed. *[[DEF |Armor DEF]] and reductions decrease the damage Safety Wall takes. *[[Perfect Dodge]] and missed attacks do not reduce Safety Wall durability. Check out [[Kyrie_Eleison#Notes|Kyrie Eleison]] for more details. == Applications == *This skill can be used to easily tank low [[ASPD]] [[monsters]] in [[PvM]] environments. High ASPD monsters can also be dealt with if the user is capable of casting this skill fast enough once it wore off, or by simply casting a new instance of this skill in a neighboring cell and moving when the previous one is about to expire. It is less effective for tanking multiple monsters, as it will quickly consume the safety wall. This is highly effective for tanking [[MVP]]s, as long as its mob can be tanked by a separate character. * In [[PvP]], this skill is useful for tanking offensive melee skills such as [[Guillotine Fist]], [[Martyr's Reckoning]] or [[Sonic Blow]] boosted with [[Enchant Deadly Poison]]. For this to be effective, the user requires sufficient [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] to cast this skill quickly before the attack occurs. ==About Traps==
*If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill.
*This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning  message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause  this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear.
*Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]].
*Traps occupy 1 cell.
*Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap.
*Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environment.
*Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP.
*Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]].

'''Scar of Tarou''' (Alt: ''Scar of Tarou'') is a [[Doram]] animal-based offensive skill available as [[Summoner]].

==Effect==

The wounded Spirit of a Tarou inflicts the same wounds on its enemy.

Inflicts Ranged Physical Damage to a single target and places an unique debuff called "Bite Scar" that drains a portion of their max HP each second. The amount of HP depends on the skill level and the caster's [[DEX]].

"Bite Scar" can be removed by [[Heal]], [[Cure]], [[Clearance]], [[High Heal]], or [[Coluseo Heal]]. This skill can't debuff Boss monsters, but instead inflicts double damage on them.

This skill has a chance of being activated twice when cast at Base Level 30 or above. This chance increases every 30 Base levels.

'''Shadow Formation''' (Alt: ''Shadow Formation'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Shadow Chaser]].

== Effect ==

Redirects any damage the caster receives to the player targeted by Shadow Form. Automatically cancels after a fixed number of hits redirected, detecting skill is used, or when targeted player moves out of range.

{| class="wikitablec"
 ! Level !! Hits !! SP Drain !! Duration

|| 5 || 10/s || 30s

|| 6 || 9/s || 40s
|-
 ! 3
|| 7 || 8/s || 50s
|-
 ! 4
|| 8 || 7/s || 60s
|-
 ! 5
|| 9 || 6/s || 70s
|}

=== Notes ===
*This skill cannot be used on monsters.
*Can be used on Players while they are in a [[Manhole]].
*Cannot use any skills or items while you are in Shadow Form.
*Shadow form is canceled if the range between player and target is greater than 10 cells.
*Cannot be dispelled, therefore can only removal methods are: target move out of range, insufficient SP upkeep, exceed the hit count, a detecting skill is used and/or duration ends.
*If you receive damage, and pass it onto another character that has [[Shield Reflect]] or reflect gear, if you are in melee range of them, some damage will be reflected back to you.
*If you are using Shadow Form on someone that has [[Defending Aura]], any ranged damage used on you WILL be reduced by defending aura. Thus, the shadow formed target will receive less damage.
**You can always divest their Shield first or [[Masquerade-Weakness]], to avoid this situation.
*If you are Shadow Forming a player who is protected by [[Sacrifice]], it will bypass Sacrifice and hit them, instead of the [[Crusader]]/[[Paladin]]/[[Royal Guard]].
**However, they will still receive the benefits of [[Defending Aura]] / [[Shield Reflect]] and the damage you deal will be reflected back to you.
*If you have a status ailment, ie, [[Burning]], it will bypass your Shadow Form and continue to hit you.
*You can be immobilized by skills like [[Warg Bite]] while in Shadow Form.
**Avoid such scenarios as you cannot move, use skills, or items until Shadow Form ends.

===Notes===
*This skill carries [[Status Effects|status effects]], whether from cards or special weapons like {{item|id=1224 Sword}}{{item|id=13031 breakers}} and {{item|id=1225 Mail}}{{item|id=13032 breakers}}.

==Applications==
*{{item|id=2138 Bradium Shield}}, {{item|id=2130 Cross Shield}} and {{item|id=2125 Strong Shield}} are good choices for the use of this skill.
*Some players prefer using this skill to cause [[Status Effects|status effects]] over [[Smite]], as it has a high range when mastered. [[Smite]] has aspects other than [[Status Effects#Stun|stunning]] that this skill does not have, and vice-versa, however.

==Effect==
Sets a trap that releases a shockwave when an enemy steps on it, draining the SP of all enemies within the area of effect.

==About Traps==
*If the player has learned [[Ranger]]'s [[Trap Research]], this skill can be used with {{item|id=7940 Specialty Alloy Traps}} instead. In which case the skills [[Remove Trap]] and [[Keen Nose]] will yield a {{item|id=7940 Special Alloy Trap}} instead of a plain {{item|id=1065 Trap}}. If both kinds of trap are present in the inventory, the plain traps will take priority as catalyst for this skill.
*This trap can be set into ''null cells''. When using this skill onto a forbidden (black) area of the map, the skill will fail with a warning  message, and no SP or Trap will be used. However, if the skill is cast onto a map square which is occupied by an object (not an entity), the SP and Trap will be consumed, but a trap will not be set and a warning message will not be issued. These map squares can be identified when the green targeting square vanishes. {{map|id=c_tower3 Clock Tower 3F}}, is an example of a map full of (non-obvious) locations that will cause  this. Many guild castles also contain map squares with this behavior, only the targeting square might not disappear.
*Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in [[War of Emperium]].
*Traps occupy 1 cell.
*Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to players, monsters or another trap.
*Traps can be activated by and will affect allies, enemies and the user in [[PvP]] environment.
*Traps have a durability of 3,500 HP.
*Traps will not activate if the user is under the effect of [[Manhole]].
*Like ground skills, traps can also be swept by [[Ganbantein]], [[Earth Drive]] and [[Crazy Vines]].
*Traps cannot be activated by the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] that enticed the trapper with [[Siren's Voice]].
*[[Siren's Voice]] protects the [[Maestro]] or [[Wanderer]] from traps of enticed trappers.

title: Skill Equipment
Skill Types
wikitext:
[[Skills]], unlike normal attacks, have a variety of different targeting systems.

== By Type ==

=== Physical Attack ===

Based on [[ATK]] and [[STR]], physical attacks can be reduced by [[DEF]] or evaded with [[Flee]].

=== Magical Attack ===

Based on [[MATK]] and [[INT]], magical attacks can be reduced by [[MDEF]].

== By Target ==

=== Self ===

A number of monster skills are self-targeted at the monster itself and then spread as an Area of Attack skill. As such, the effects of the skill influence targets within a certain distance of the monster.

=== Single Target ===

Single target skills are directed at a single player or monster, although [[Area of Effect]] skills may cause damage to surrounding opponents as well.

=== Multiple Target ===

Multiple target skills are directed at one or more targets at once, and each may attempt to evade the skill individually; one target my successfully flee the attack, but other targets may still take damage.

=== Ground Target ===

Skill which target the ground are generally blocked by [[Magnetic Earth]].

== By Range ==

Most player skills have a set range, as indicated on their individual articles. Monster skills, however, may have different range conditions depending on the target's distance from the caster.

=== Melee Range ===

Melee skills have a range determined by the user's weapon. They are otherwise classed as Close Range.

=== Close Range ===

Monster skills are considered close range if the monster is less than 4 cells away from the target at the time of casting.
* Close range physical skills can be blocked by [[Safety Wall]].

=== Long Range ===

All player magic is classified as long range. Monster skills are considered long range if the monster is more than 4 cells away from the target at the time of casting.
* Long range physical skills can be blocked by [[Pneuma]].
* All long range skills are reduced by cards such as Noxious and Alligator.

== By Use ==

=== Support ===

Support skills are skills that do not damage, but do other effects. This may be such things as buffs, healing, or status effects

=== Offense ===

Offensive skills are used in a form of direct damage. They will damage the enemy in almost all instances, unless a requirement has not been made.

== By User ==

=== Monster Skills ===

Monster skills, or NPC skills, are skills that are only to be used by NPCs. They cannot be actively cast by players, nor copied by [[Intimidate]].

=== Player Skills ===

Player skills are skills that can be actively used by a playable character. If player skill damages another player, then it can be copied by [[Intimidate]], unless it is a transcendent skill.

title: Skills
wikitext:
'''Skills''' in Ragnarok Online are special actions a player can perform depending on his/her [[Classes|Job Class]]. There are two types of skills: Active and Passive. Active skills can be manually activated by the player, where some of them remain active for a set period of time, others can be manually deactivated, and some are one-time-use skills that require manual activation each time the player desires to use them. Passive skills are always in effect, they do not need input from the player to provide its benefit as long as the player has learned those skills. Active skills can be broken down into 3 sub-categories: "Offensive", "Supportive" and "Active". Offensive skills are those that inflict damage to their selected targets or in a wide area. Supportive skills are those that provide helpful effects to other players, like boosting their offensive and defensive capabilities. Plainly Active skills are those that do not fit in the two forementioned categories and only affect the player or a certain area, usually for a set period of time. ==Skill Phases== The skill usage is performed through the following phases: ;Initiation:Skill name appears above the character's head. ;Cast Time:A gauge appears above the character's head. If there is no Cast Time it is then executed instantaneously. ;Execution:Skill name appears above the character's head again and its effect is triggered. ;Cast Delay:All skills are temporarily grayed out after execution, blocking their use. Most skills have this value. ;Cooldown:Only the skill used is temporarily grayed out after its execution, blocking their use. Not all skills have this value. Cast Delay and Cooldown start at the same time. No skill can be used if there is still Cast Delay, and any other skill can be used if only Cooldown remains. ===Initiation=== This phase occurs when the character uses the skill. SP Cost and other requirements are checked, but do not take effect. If the character cannot fulfill the SP Cost or the other requirements, the skill will not activate. ===Cast Time=== During '''Cast Time''', the character cannot move, attack, or use other skills. If the character takes damage during Cast Time, the skill is canceled (exceptions: wearing a {{item|id=4077 Phen Card}} or {{item|id=4327 Bloody Butterfly Card}}, being [[Sacrifice]]d by a [[Crusader]]/[[Paladin]]/[[Royal Guard]], or while casting certain skills). If a skill has no base Cast Time or modifiers reduce the effective Cast Time to 0 or less, no cast gauge appears and this phase is skipped entirely. Cast Time is indicated by a "progress gauge" above the character's head, sometimes called "Cast Bar". The gauge starts out black and is filled with green as Cast Time proceeds. When the cast bar is completely green, Cast Time ends. Some skills do not have a cast bar, even though they have a casting time, such as [[Bowling Bash]] and [[Brandish Spear]]. Cast Time is composed of "Variable Cast Time" (VCT) and "Fixed Cast Time" (FCT). As the names may imply, VCT depends on the [[stats]] and gear of the caster, while FCT is constant for a given skill. A small number of effects can reduce FCT. Effects which reduce FCT by a percentage do not stack; effects which reduce FCT by a set amount do stack, and are applied before percentage modifiers. For most skills, FCT is 20% of the total Cast Time, with the remainder being VCT. VCT is reduced by [[Stats#DEX|DEX]], and also [[Stats#INT|INT]] at half the amount. ====Calculation==== '''Cast Time (seconds) =''' VCT + FCT '''VCT (seconds) =''' (BaseVCT - Sum_VCT) × (1 − SQRT[{DEX × 2 + INT} ÷ 530]) × (1 − Sum_GearVCTReduc ÷ 100) × (1 − Sum_SkillVCTReduc ÷ 100) '''FCT (seconds) =''' (BaseFCT - Sum_FCT) × (1 − Max_FCTReduc ÷ 100) * '''BaseVCT''' = Base Variable Cast Time of a skill. * '''BaseFCT''' = Base Fixed Cast Time of a skill. * '''Sum_GearVCTReduc''' = Sum of reductions for Variable Cast Time from gear and cards, like {{item|id=420199 Ghost Fire}}, {{item |id=4366 Kathryne Keyron Card}}, and {{item|id=4412 Isilla Card}}. * '''Sum_SkillVCTReduc''' = Sum of reductions for Variable Cast Time from skills, like [[Magic Strings]], [[Suffragium]], and [[16th Night]], and some items that give variable cast reduction to specific skills, like {{item|id=4433 Imp Card}}, {{item|id=4416 Siroma Card}}, {{item|id=19125 Cylinder Hairband}}, or {{item|id=5898 Autumn Headband}}. * '''Sum_VCT''' = Sum of all effects that directly subtract from Variable Cast Time (like {{item|id=32263 Shield Ring}}). * '''Sum_FCT''' = Sum of all effects that directly subtract from Fixed Cast Time (or add to it, like [[Mandragora Howling]]). * '''Max_FCTReduc''' = Highest reduction modifier of Fixed Cast Time (for example: if both [[Sacrament]] (50%) and [[Radius]] (20%) are active, only [[Sacrament]] will work) ====Modifiers for Fixed Cast Time==== {|class="wikitable sortable" !Skill/Enchant !data-sort-type=number|{{Tooltip|Max Modifier|For FCT}} !class=unsortable|Additional Notes |- |{{rh}}|[[16th Night]] |style="text-align:center;"|100% |See skill description |- |{{rh}}|[[Legacy_of_the_Wise_One_(17.2)_Equipment_and_Enchants#Automatic_Modules_Enchantment|Automatic Modification Orb (Fixed Cast Time)]] |style="text-align:center;"|-0.1 ~ -0.8 seconds |Starts at -0.1 seconds.
Additional -0.2 seconds if upgrade level is +7 or higher.

However, there are random times he will be implemented by WarpPortal outside of the Christmas season. ===Notes=== *Even after doing a Skill Reset, a character cannot put 1st class skill points into 2nd class skills, or 2nd class skill points into 3rd class skills. The game will force the character to put all of their 1st class skill points into 1st class skills before the character is able to acquire 2nd class skill points and so on. *If, when your character was a 1st class character, they promoted to 2nd class below the maximum Job Level, they will never be able to recover the lost points. Thus, it is always recommended to reach the max Job Level before promoting (although some players may choose to promote early before [[transcendent|transcending]] as all stats and skills are reset anyway). For example: **If an [[Acolyte]] promoted to [[Priest]] at Job Level 45 instead of Job Level 50, they will still only get 44 skill points (instead of 49) out of the Acolyte skill points after doing a skill reset. **If a [[High Priest]] promotes to [[Arch Bishop]] at Job Level 67 instead of Job Level 70, they will still only get 66 skill points (instead of 69) out of the High Priest skill points after doing a skill reset. ==See Also== *[[Guild System#Skills|Guild Skills]] *[[:Category:Monster Exclusive Skills|Monster Exclusive Skills]] *[[Template:Skill Info]] {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category:Skills]] [[Category:Mechanics]]

'''Smite''' (Alt: ''Shield Charge'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Crusader]] and [[Paladin]].
==Effect==
Smashes the equipped shield into a single target to inflict [[ATK|physical damage]] and push it backwards. It has a chance of leaving the target [[Status Effects#Stun|stunned]].

===Notes===
*This skill carries [[Status Effects|status effects]]. [[Items]] or [[Card System|cards]] that have a chance to [[Status Effects#Stun|stun]] enemies while attacking them stack with the Stun chance of this skill.
*This skill is not effective when the user is mounting a [[Peco Peco Ride|Peco Peco]] without having mastered [[Cavalier Mastery]], since its delay is affected by [[ASPD]].

==Applications==
*A great skill to use to knock people out of [[Pneuma]], also because it gives players awful position lag, making it difficult for them to recast [[Pneuma]]. It can also be used to knock players out of [[Sacrifice]]'s range, but may be difficult if the user is not mounting a [[Peco Peco Ride|Peco Peco]].
*An excellent skill to use to [[Status Effects#Stun|stun]] opponents in [[War of Emperium]] if the user has high [[ASPD]] since the Knock Back is disabled and the skill may be spammed continuously.

'''Snap''' (Alt: ''Body Relocation'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Monk]] and [[Champion]].

==Effect==
Instantly transports the user to a targeted location in a straight line, providing no solid obstacle exists between the user and the destination. Each cast uses a [[Spirit Sphere]] unless the user is in [[Fury]] status, in which case this skill will use none.

===Notes===
*There is a Cast Delay of 2 seconds for a casted [[Guillotine Fist]] immediately after this skill.
*Players do not count as an obstacle. [[Monk]]s ''can'' Snap their way through crowds of people or even directly behind a player.
*The user will be completely unaffected by any obstacles in the way when moving with this skill. [[Fire Wall]]s will not be harmful. Neither will Traps.
*Snapping away will save the user from [[:Category:AoE Skills|area skills]], but will not release them from most single-target skills, even if they have moved all the way off the screen from the attacker (unless the attacker no longer has a line of sight to the caster). An exception is that this skill can release the player from [[Fiber Lock]].
*Despite the "moving" animation, the character does not really take any time at all to Snap. The slight delay that may be encountered is simply lag, and the movement is truly instant.
*This skill cannot be used in [[Battlegrounds]].
*This skill cannot be used in [[Al de Baran Turbo Track]].

==External==
===Enhanced by===

**If upgrade level is +5 or higher, reduces SP cost by 5.
**If upgrade level is +7 or higher, reduces SP cost by an additional 5.

'''Soul Exhale''' (Alt: ''Soul Change'') is a [[Transcendent]] 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Scholar]].
==Effect==
Exchanges the current SP of a single target and the caster at cost of half of the exchanged SP.

===Notes===
*The Shift key must be held in order to use this skill on [[party]] members out of [[PvP]] environment.

==Applications==
*As an example, if the caster had 1000 SP and the target had 100 SP, the caster's current SP would decrease to 50 and and target's current SP would increase to 500.
*This skill can be used offensively in [[PvP]] environment to halve other players' current SP while restoring caster's own SP.
*If the target has zero SP, the caster's SP will be completely drained after using this skill. Therefore the caster has to wait for the [[SP Recovery]] or use low-end [[Healing Items#SP Restoration Items|SP healing items]]. This is because [[Indulge]] cannot be used without at least some SP.

title: Spell Fist
wikitext: __NOTOC__ {{Skill Info |class=Sorcerer |type=Offensive |levels=5 (Selectable) |prereqs=([[Sage]]) [[Hindsight]] Lv. 4 |spcost=36 + (Skill Level × 4) |delay=1 second |duration=30 + (Skill Level × 15) seconds |target=Self }} '''Spell Fist''' (Alt: ''Spell Fist'') is a 3rd class offensive skill available as [[Sorcerer]]. ==Effect== Interrupts the ongoing cast of the current Bolt skill and converges its magic power on the caster's hands, allowing to inflict [[MATK|magic damage]] with regular attacks temporarily. This skill can only be used while casting either [[Fire Bolt]], [[Cold Bolt]] or [[Lightning Bolt]], the property of which depends the property of this skill. {|class=wikitablec !Level!!Base Damage (MATK)!!Duration!!SP Cost |- !1 |20%||45s||40 |- !2 |40%||60s||44 |- !3 |60%||75s||48 |- !4 |80%||90s||52 |- !5 |100%||10s||56 |- !6 |120%||120s||60 |- !7 |140%||135s||64 |- !8 |160%||150s||68 |- !9 |180%||165s||72 |- !10 |200%||180s||76 |} '''{{tooltip|Damage|For each hit}} (MATK)% =''' Base_Damage + Bolt_Lv × 100% ===Notes=== *Each attack consumes 20sp and this skill is cancelled if user reaches 0 sp. *This skill is considered [[Melee]] magic damage. Due to this: **It is blocked by [[Safety Wall]] and [[Guard]]. **It is affected by [[Shield Reflect]]. **It is affected by [[Double Attack]]. **It is affected by Melee damage increase such as [[Dark Claw]] **Its damage is reduced by [[NPC STONESKIN|Stone Skin]]. **It can trigger [[Autocast]]s that are based on regular attacks, including those spells triggered via [[Hindsight]]. However, the [[Skills#Cast Delay|Cast Delay]] of the spells might make it more difficult to reload this skill quickly. *The level of [[Free Cast]] directly affects the reaction time of this skill after casting a Bolt skill, as it is based on the [[ASPD|attack speed]]. *Any damage modifier that affects the Bolt skills will also affect this skill. Such as {{item|id=4416 Siroma Card}} ([[Cold Bolt]]) and {{item|id=4433 Imp Card}} ([[Fire Bolt]]). *Since the way the damage of this skill is calculated is same way as how the Bolt skills are calculated, the [[MDEF|magic defense]] of the enemy will greatly reduce the overall damage (the [[MDEF|magic defense]] reduces base [[MATK|magic attack]] and then is multiplied by the Bolt / Spell Fist multiplier). *The weapon equipped when converging a Bolt skill does not affect damage. Only the weapon equipped when hitting an enemy after having activated the skill does. For example, casting with a [[rod]] and then hitting with a [[dagger]] will result in lower damage, while casting with a [[dagger]] and then hitting with a [[rod]] will result in higher damage. *This skill does not benefit physical damage cards like {{item|id=4035 Hydra}}, {{item|id=4082 Desert Wolf}}, etc. *'''Despite description stating that damage is increased by base level, it does not (correct description is damage increased by Skill level)''' ==Applications== *The damage is connected in one single hit. For example, if a Level 10 Bolt skill is converged with this skill at Level 5 and each bolt would inflict 500 damage, the enemy would receive {{tooltip|6,250|500 × (2,5 + 10)}} damage in one single attack. This is particularly helpful if using a card, such as {{item|id=4115 Hunter Fly}}, that relies on higher damage output at once as opposed to several smaller hits. ==Changelog== *October 13th, 2022 **Damage Lowered. ***Old: Skill_Lv × 50 + Bolt_Lv × 100 ***New: Skill_Lv × 20 + Bolt_Lv × 100 **Removed Hit Limit. **Added 20 sp Cost per Attack. **Added debuff. {{Navbox Sage}}

==Effect==
Summons a vicious blizzard upon a targeted location that lasts for 4.5 seconds, inflicting [[Water]] property [[MATK|magic damage]] every 0.5 seconds to all enemies within its area of effect and push them 2 cells in random directions. ===Notes===
*[[Status Effects#Frozen|Frozen]] enemies will not take further damage from this skill.
*This skill cannot [[Status Effects#Frozen|freeze]] [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] and [[Undead]] property enemies.
*This skill does not stack with other instances of this skill; two simultaneous instances in one location have no more effect than just one. This is important in [[War of Emperium|WoE]] precasts. The reason for this is that anything hit by this skill is temporarily immune to the skill for half a second. In this way it is similar to [[Lord of Vermilion]] and [[Priest]]'s [[Magnus Exorcismus]].
*Each cell affected by this skill unconditionally splashes a surrounding 3x3 area. This means that the actual [[Area of Effect|area of effect]] of the skill is effectively 11x11. Anything right outside the "Casting Ring" will be hit.

==Applications==
*Since [[MVP]]s can not be [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]], this skill can inflict reliable damage.
*Since [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] targets take more damage from [[Wind]] property, they become more susceptible to [[Jupitel Thunder]] and [[Lord of Vermilion]]. Due to the [[DEF|defense]] reduction, [[Status Effects#Frozen|frozen]] targets can also be dealt with by heavy [[melee]] burst damage.
*Since Level 10 has lower chances to [[Status Effects#Frozen|freeze]], targets have a better chance to take more damage. [[Wizard]]s who wants to [[Status Effects#Frozen|freeze]] their victims should use a lower level of this skill.

* Creates an instant fire in a 7x7 area around the target and Ardor, burning enemies within the range. Inflicts [[MATK]] 2400% fire property magic damage that ignores the target's magic defense. Damage is additionally increased according to the summoner's base level.
