title: Taekwon Mission
wikitext: {{Skill Info |class=TaeKwon Kid |type=Active |levels=1 |prereqs=([[TaeKwon Kid]]) [[Kihop]] Lv. 5 |spcost=10 |cast_fix=1 second |target=Self }} '''Taekwon Mission''' (Alt: ''TaeKwon Mission'') is an Expanded class active skill available as and '''only''' as [[TaeKwon Kid]]. If the player has promoted to [[TaeKwon Master]] or [[Soul Linker]], this skill is no longer usable. ==Effect== Assigns a random monster as the current Mission Target. If the target is killed 100 times (does not have to be consecutive), the player will be awarded with 1 Fame Point and a new random monster will be assigned as the next Mission Target. The assigned monster will never be an [[MVP]] but can be a [[Boss Protocol#Mini Boss|Mini Boss]]. ===Notes=== *If there already is an assigned Mission Target and its Target Percent is still at 0% (no monster killed yet), each cast has an 1% chance of reassigning a new Mission Target randomly. *If the Mission Target is "Goblin", any monster called "Goblin" will count toward the current Mission (all five Goblins will count, but not {{monster|id=1280 Goblin Steamrider}}) ==Fame System== TaeKwon ranks can be checked via prompt of the /taekwon command ingame. '''[[TaeKwon Kid]]s''' who are in the top ten list and are over Level 90 will have their [[Max HP]] and [[Max SP]] tripled and will be able to use all of the TaeKwon Kid skills. TaeKwon Rankers can perform an infinite combo of all four kicks, but they must prepare the stance of at least one of said kicks and spam the hotkeys when it triggers. Also, the kicks must be alternated; performing the same kick twice in a row ends the spam. The exception to this is [[Flying Kick]], which cannot be used to continue a kick combo (but can be used infinitely without stance activation, as usual). {{Navbox TaeKwon Kid}}

'''Talkie Box''' (Alt: ''Talkie Box'') is a 2<sup>nd</sup> class active skill available as [[Hunter]] and [[Sniper]].
==Effect==
Sets a trap on a targeted location that displays a prerecorded text message to any player that steps on it.

===Notes===
* This trap will activate when stepped on by a player, but not by monsters and the trap's owner.
* This trap can be placed under entities, even other Talkie Boxes.
* This trap can be activated by [[Detonator]].
* This trap can be knocked back.

==Applications==
*Useful for alerting other players when there is a [[MVP]] in the connecting map.
*It can be used as a "free leechable entity" for players (as well as monsters with vampire's gift) since this trap doesn't have any determined HP, so it won't be destroyed when receiving damage. This can only be done when the user is wearing HP leeching gears and cards:
**Stack these traps on top of another, place [[Fire Trap]] beside this trap, detonate [[Fire Trap]] so it will damage this trap.
** When trying to leech from this trap, make sure not to include it in [[Detonator]]'s 7x7 range when you're trying to detonate the [[Fire Trap]]s/[[Ice Trap]]s.
** It is also possible to use this trap to help other classes leech HP & SP (ex. [[Guillotine Cross]] classes with [[Rolling Cutter]], etc.)

[[Category:Forced Element Skills]]
'''Tetra Vortex''' (Alt: ''Tetra Vortex'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Warlock]].
==Effect==
Inflicts [[MATK|Magic Damage]] to a single target multiple times by using the elemental orbs summoned through their respective skills ([[Summon Fire Ball|Fire]], [[Summon Water Ball|Water]], [[Summon Lightning Ball|Lightning]], [[Summon Stone|Stone]]). It always leaves them [[Status Effects#Burning|burning]], [[Status Effects#Freezing|freezing]], [[Status Effects#Stun|stunned]] or [[Status Effects#Bleeding|bleeding]], depending on the property of each orb. Each cast uses 4 elemental orbs in any order, the property of which depend the property of each hit.

===Notes===
*The last 4 orbs summoned by the caster are used to inflict damage, in backwards order, completely ignoring the first orb summoned if 5 were summoned. For examples:
**'''4 orbs:''' If the caster has summoned 3 [[Summon Fire Ball|Fire Balls]] and then 1 [[Summon Water Ball|Water Ball]] in that order, this skill will inflict [[Water]]-[[Fire]]-[[Fire]]-[[Fire]] damage.
**'''5 orbs:''' If the caster has summoned 2 [[Summon Stone|Stones]], 2 [[Summon Fire Ball|Fire Balls]] and 1 [[Summon Lightning Ball|Lightning Ball]] in that order, this skill will inflict [[Wind]]-[[Fire]]-[[Fire]]-[[Earth]] damage, completely ignoring the first Stone summoned, which is still consumed.
*When used by monsters, this skill inflicts Neutral element damage.

'''Thorn Wall''' (Alt: ''Wall of Thorns'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class offensive skill available as [[Geneticist]].
==Effect==
Produces a wall of thorns around a single target, which will inflict damage in contact and push 2 cells backwards. If the wall is struck by a [[Fire]] property attack, it becomes [[Fire Wall]] of the same level as this skill level used (Level 5 becomes Level 5 [[Fire Wall]]). Each cast consumes a {{item|id=6210 Thorn Plant Seed}}.

===Notes===
*Only one thorn wall can be active at the same time.
*A thorn wall can be destroyed by attacking it, much like [[Ice Wall]].
*The maximum number of hits is 20.
*The duration of this skill when transformed into a [[Fire Wall]] is the duration of the skill time effect before transformation.
*Relative Modifier damage cards do not affect damage. 
*This skill has a knockback effect on players, even in [[PvM]] maps.
*On iRO, this skill has been disabled in [[War of Emperium]] castles and cities.

Grants a 20% chance of preparing this stance to dodge ranged physical and magical attacks, including [[Area of Effect|area]] skills. When the user is in [[Sprint|Spurt]] status, the user will also be able to dodge melee attacks. During this stance, [[Flying Kick]] can be used immediately against the attacker and its damage is increased based on the user's [[Levels#Base Level|Base Level]].

===Notes===
*The 20% chance to dodge an attack is checked after the attack actually "hits", but before it has any effect. Even otherwise unavoidable attacks like critical hits and spells can be dodged.
*Skills that inflict "Damage Bundle" ([[Thunder Storm]], [[Sonic Blow]], etc.) are treated as a single hit, therefore they can be fully dodged. Skills that inflict damage over separate hits ([[Storm Gust]], [[Meteor Storm]] (each meteor), [[Water Ball]], etc.) can be dodged one hit at a time.
*There is a slight delay before the player can do anything or even move when dodging an attack. This may be a disadvantage if the player is getting mobbed.

Throws a venom knife at a single target to inflict 500% ranged [[ATK|physical damage]]. It has a chance of leaving the target [[Status Effects#Poison|poisoned]].

===Notes===

'''Verdure Trap''' (Alt: ''Verdure Trap '') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

== Effect ==
A maximum of 1 trap can be placed at once. Permanently changes the monster that steps on this trap and any monster in a 5x5 area around this trap to [[Wind]] Element. Does not affect boss type monsters or players, and consumes one Wind of Verdure and a Special Alloy Trap.

== Information == 
* This trap can be placed under players and monsters.
* This trap will yield only 1 Special Alloy Trap when affected by [[Keen Nose]].
* This trap has a 3x3 activation area and can only activate 0.5s after it has been placed.
* This trap disappears instantly once activated.
* This trap can be knocked back by AoE skills like [[Arrow Shower]] and [[Magnum Break]].
* This trap can be destroyed by [[Trample]].

== General Trap information ==
* Trap Duration lasts 4 times as long in WoE.
* Traps occupy 1 cell.
* Traps can only be placed up to 2 cells next to another Trap.
* Traps will not activate if the caster is under the effect of [[Manhole]].

'''Warg Dash''' (Alt: ''Wug Dash'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class active skill available as [[Ranger]].

== Effect ==
Usable only when mounted on your Warg. Your warg will run in a straight line, and re-using the skill orders it to stop. You will automatically stop when colliding with another object be it a wall, NPC or etc.

=== Notes ===
* The rider needs at least one open cell in front to use the skill.
* This is a really good skill to escape from mobs since you almost guaranteed to get off from the mob when you use this skill (as long as there is no monster in front of you), therefore this skill is perfect for pulling and kiting.
* Current walking speed affects warg dash speed, it is recommended to use wind walker first before performing warg dash. 
* You will deal damage in a 3x3 area when you stop (either by reusing the skill or hitting an object).
* Damage formula : ATK 300% + (Caster’s Current Weight x 10 / 8) + Tooth of Warg bonus
* If you are hit, immobilized, or stopped by certain skills, you will stop moving but still be considered in dash status - therefore, the rider needs to use the skill again before acting normally.

==Effect==

<sup>Levels 6 and higher can only be bestowed from {{monster|id=1990 Naga}}, {{monster|id=1112 '''Drake'''}} or {{monster|id=1779 '''Ktullanux'''}} through [[Rogue]]'s [[Intimidate]] skill. [[Wizard]]s and [[Super Novice]]s can only learn it up to Level 5 naturally.</sup>

===Notes===
*This skill can be cast on [[Sage]]'s [[Deluge]] and [[Ninja]]'s [[Watery Evasion]], but it will use the cells and they will be removed after casting.
*The number of water balls that can be launched depends on the amount of water the caster is standing in. Using higher levels of this skill without enough water will not produce the maximum number of hits.
*There is a notable delay between the completion of casting and when water balls inflict damage. This can be used to escape or cast a second skill.
*Unlike the majority of magic skills, water balls inflict individual damage for each ball on each impact instead of a bundle of full damage on cast completion. This gives the opportunity for the opponent to change armors or cast skills.
*Also unlike most skills, the delay of this skill does not correspond directly to the balls impacting the target. It is possible to cast another skill before all balls have finished impacting.
*Some monsters have a more powerful variation of this skill, which draws water from a 9x9 area under the user and launches 100 water balls.
*In addition to Level 1 [[Cold Bolt]] and Level 1 [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Super Novice]]s also have a prerequisite of doing the [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|Expansion Quest]]. [[Wizard]]s only require the forementioned skills.
*This skill can be prevented from casted by using [[Magnetic Earth]] below the caster of the skills. Note that the higher the level of Water Ball used, more cells have to be blanketed by [[Magnetic Earth]] to prevent it from being casted completely.
*This skill can be stopped once it starts by using skills that occupies or removes ground cells, like [[Magnetic Earth]], [[Fire Rain]], or  [[Crazy Vines]]. Since this skills consume cells 1 by 1 as its "ammunition" starting at bottom left cells and going to the right, row after row, it is better to put the cancelling skills on the top part of the Water Ball cells area, since the remaining cells is located at the top row, and the bottom row area has already been used to launch Water Ball.

'''Wind Insignia''' (Alt: ''Wind Insignia'') is a 3<sup>rd</sup> class supportive skill available as [[Sorcerer]].

==Effect==
Create a 3x3 [[Wind]] property crest on the targeted location, where [[Wind]] property entities will regain 1% HP every 5 seconds, [[Water]] property entities will drain 1% HP every 5 seconds, and [[Earth]] property damage will increase by 50%. Each cast consumes {{item|id=6362 Yellow Wish Points}} depending on the skill level.

*Weapon property changes work even on enemies, including [[Boss Protocol|Boss]] [[monster]]s.
*Does not require any Elemental Spirit out, it can be used like any [[:Category:Active Skills|Active]] skill.

wikitext: {{Skill Info |class=Champion |type=Active |levels=1 |prereqs=([[Monk]]) [[Fury]] Lv. 5 |spcost=20 |cast_fix=1 second |target=Self }} '''Zen''' (Alt: ''Dangerous Soul Collect'') is a [[transcendent]] 2nd class active skill available as [[Champion]]. __TOC__ ==Effect== Summons all [[Spirit Sphere]]s the user can get. ==Applications== *This skill will grant up to 15 spheres at once when under the effect of [[Rising Dragon]]. *This skill along with [[Spiritual Sphere Absorption]] can be used as a quick SP recovery skill, since [[Zen]] consumes 20 SP and absorbing 5 spheres would give the user 35 SP (7 × 5 = 35). This method can be used during the 3 seconds of SP drought from [[Guillotine Fist]] as well. *This SP recovery method is enhanced with [[Rising Dragon]], as [[Power Absorb]] will absorb all Spirit Spheres at once, for a maximum of 15% Max SP and more if other players with spheres are in range. ==External== ===Bestowed from=== *{{item|id=1827 Glorious Fist}} - Level 1; 100% chance to autocast on self when using [[Fury]], if upgrade level is +9 or higher. ===Enhanced by=== *{{item|id=28386 Fallen Monk Rosary [1]}} - Reduces SP cost by 5. *{{item|id=22145 Tengu Shoes}} - For every level known of [[Gentle Touch-Energy Gain]], reduces fixed casting time by 10%. ==History== {{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=Zen&oldid=59549 This page}} has the previous version of this skill before the 2020 skill updates. ==Changelog== *{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=320&p=1 May 1st, 2020}} **Fixed casting time reduced from 2 second to 1 second. {{Navbox Monk}} [[Category:Spirit Sphere Skills]]
